Kamala Harris has been a mentor and friend for more than 14 years, and I
often even refer to her as “my quintessential big sister,” because she
always shows up for me when I need her.

In fact, when I first won my race to become Prince George’s County
Executive, one of the first calls I received was from her.

I’d like to share one piece of advice that she shared with me: More
important than being first at something is to make sure you are not the
last.

And now that we’re standing on the precipice of electing our country’s
first woman president, that advice feels more appropriate than ever.

This whole election cycle boils down to this,
Peter: Will our country be dragged
backwards, reverting back to an era of fear, overreach, and fewer rights?

Or will we come together, build a winning, vibrant coalition of supporters
who recognize that we’re stronger, and better, when we come together as a
country and embrace progress?

That’s why we need to win BOTH the White House and the Senate in November,
but it’s going to take the biggest, broadest grassroots movement our state

Team: We're hearing from allies on the ground that up to 500,000 Georgians are at risk of having their voter registration “purged” before Election Day.
Partisan election officials conduct mass registered voter removals, as required by recent Georgia voter suppression laws -- laws that include limits on mail-in ballots, the criminalization of giving out water to voters waiting in line, and so much more.
T hese purges disenfranchise legitimate registered voters who haven’t moved or had other changes to their status as voters . Multiple stories written by the Atlanta Journal-Constitution in recent years have highlighted wrongfully purged voters and show the evidence clearly.
This comes after groups based outside of Georgia brought massed challenges against almost 400,000 Georgia voters in the 2022 general election and runoff. That doesn't include the 92,000 additional challenges brought in Georgia by amateur " voter fraud hunters " who believe the lies peddled by partisan activists trying to shake our faith in our elections and guarantee their party wins elections.

**Meet Bernie Moreno:** | [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=26baf9f7e14f491aa2e7e56a14d22922&_e=bXptbJ4Kxlg2aUe59Jls0rcm_1e5bf3yUL8IwwnVBfweW84TvWACUZCUg8qSuD-NduYUszyyobAOcV6vZV-G1eMX7E-cNAWHB7ZAMs4kHKebKuserCLKlONKxWtf7KiSlhxJztRAQSi_743oRCgculcvqRk_cO7d-OKoqEaxxKsxu9Vs8hAWlyG_7joqvNQ3D0NCLbB1VNi7noQydaYIZg_GWXBvJXvtSNstAfSOcUhPv0BfSUqinkQi23HBXKnDEnLpuTuw5CH7ccm-g_scMxTBYdJgUIhheAlFLkvkZN_WMBvbFb3w9tP6zsuthOZIB0j1gpF0nknOs16j77KQ-4LMLXimqc2o7QOBc9xjHAtZQt1CTsA4ETPWd770fveyG6dikTngFCq82k3Eg50Y4xzhHEdNn-3QKTtafPCharg%3D) Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

Even though Sarah and some of the team are at the Democratic convention in Chicago right now, it’s still a busy week at McBride HQ!

Peter — I’m honored
and grateful to earn the Democratic nomination to represent Wisconsin in
the U.S. Senate.

Now, the real fight begins as the general election is underway.

Last Tuesday’s results have made it official: I’m running against an

Defending this seat won’t be easy.

Hovde and his GOP allies have already launched a $26 million ad blitz
across Wisconsin. Hovde’s eliminated the polling gap in our race — and his

presidential immunity for “official acts” — giving him legal cover for
inciting the January 6 insurrection among many other alleged crimes, and
giving him carte blanche to commit new crimes if he is elected again.

On July 13, a 20-year-old gunman took his father’s AR-15 rifle in a
horrifying attempt to carry out an assassination at a Trump rally in
Butler, Pennsylvania that nearly killed the former president and cost an
innocent bystander their life.

On July 15, the Trump-appointed Judge Aileen Cannon dismissed the
classified documents case brought by the Justice Department against Trump
— Cannon’s latest in a series of actions designed to stall the
investigation and help Trump legally.

That afternoon, Trump selected JD Vance as his vice presidential running
mate.

That evening, FEC reports revealed Steve Garvey had outraised our campaign
by $1.2 million in the last three months, and the Republican National
Convention began in Milwaukee.

The media was quick to ascribe a near-death experience change to Trump’s
nature, desperate to describe him as more peaceful, more serene. Trump
disagreed.

“They all say, ‘I think he’s changed since two weeks ago. Something
affected him.’ No, I haven’t changed. Maybe I’ve gotten worse.”

bravery, he dropped out of the presidential race and endorsed his Vice
President and running mate, Kamala Harris.

Vice President Harris immediately went to work unifying and reenergizing
our party.

On August 6, she announced Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her running
mate.

And today, Derek,
the Democratic National Convention
begins in Chicago.

retake the House majority, and help Vice President Harris and Governor

**President Biden just gave an INCREDIBLE speech at the Democratic National Convention!**

He called on us to defend our democracy from Donald Trump, and he made the case for why Americans must unite behind VP Kamala Harris and Gov. Tim Walz!

_We’re so proud to have him as our president, and so excited to work alongside him to elect VP Harris as our next president!_

That’s why we’re sending him a MASSIVE thank you card for his leadership and his amazing speech – [**we’re sending the card tomorrow at 9am sharp, sign now to secure your spot! »**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48637?t=7&akid=21884%2E4449941%2E4ocKzZ) | [10,000 SIGNATURE GOAL: CHIP IN $7 AND SIGN PRESIDENT BIDEN’S THANK YOU CARD »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48637?t=8&akid=21884%2E4449941%2E4ocKzZ)

_– Fight for Reform_
TO: President Biden
FROM: A Proud Democrat

Dear President Biden,

I’m so grateful for your leadership in your long-spanning career! **Your speech tonight was inspiring and a great reminder of your incredible service to our country.**

From the Senate, to the Vice Presidency, up to the Presidency, you’ve always led boldly, compassionately, and fairly.

With you in office, I’ve always been able to rest easily knowing that our democracy is safeguarded.

**And your selfless decision to step aside and allow VP Kamala Harris to run for president has again put our democracy first!** [**That’s why I’m signing this card to thank you for your leadership and chipping in $7 to Fight for Reform to make sure we elect state and local Democrats who will protect our democracy and fight against MAGA extremism »**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48637?t=9&akid=21884%2E4449941%2E4ocKzZ) Sincerely yours,

__x A Proud Democrat__

name: Dr. Asif Mahmood
subject: Thank You President Biden
body:
#HealthCareWorkers4Kamala | | | | | |
---
| **THANK YOU JOE!**
---
|
As we honor President Biden for his lifetime of service and his work to unite our country, the energy at the close of the first night of the Democratic National Convention was truly invigorating. Reflecting on the inspiring speeches from Secretary Clinton, AOC, and many others, it is clear how much is at stake in this election. We must come together to elect Vice President Harris, who will continue the fight for equity, justice, and progress for all Americans. That’s why I am proud to announce the launch of [**HealthcareWorkers4Kamala.com**](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=c0034a8b46&e=7b1b739a89)
We have witnessed the devastating impact of the Trump administration on public health and reproductive rights. We cannot afford to go backward. If Trump is re-elected, he will continue his efforts to repeal Obamacare, further reduce women’s rights, and cut Medicare funding. We must not allow this to happen.With the leadership of a Harris administration, we can build on the progress made and create a better future for all. Please visit [**HealthcareWorkers4Kamala.com**](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=d30e1f4ff7&e=7b1b739a89)[ ](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=c80c11d0fe&e=7b1b739a89)to sign up, donate to her campaign, and access important information to share with undecided friends and family. Let’s keep the momentum going as we look ahead to the next three nights of the convention. Together, we can make a difference and shape the future of our country.
As healthcare workers, we have taken an oath to do no harm and to safeguard the well-being of our patients. The stakes in this election are higher than ever. Electing Vice President Kamala Harris is not just crucial—it is imperative for the health and prosperity of our patients, our communities, and our country. Now is the time to stand united, to use our collective voice, and to fight for the future we know is possible. Let’s come together and make the decisive difference that will shape the course of our nation.Sincerely.
Dr. Asif Mahmood

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: can you believe she did this??
disclaimer_text: paid for by taxpayers
body:
They’ll get away with anything...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

With the Democrat National Convention (DNC) beginning today, abortion is set to take center stage.

Kamala Harris and Tim Walz are betting it ALL on the abortion issue this November, so I expect virtually every speaker who takes the stage in Chicago to talk about how critical it is that abortionists keep killing as many babies as possible.

Of course, they won’t put it that way . . . _They know how bad the truth sounds to people!_

So, they’ll talk about “reproductive freedom” or even “abortion healthcare” as they completely ignore the humanity of the preborn little boys and girls their pals at _Planned Parenthood_ put to death by the hundreds of thousands every year.

...and will be putting to death right there in the Chicago streets with their DNC abortion truck...which they are now bragging has a wait list!

But Pro-Life Friend, they won’t just stop at the lying and euphemisms.

If it was just that, it would be bad enough.

_Now, they’ve moved on from lying to attacking anyone who dares to speak the TRUTH about abortion! And Kamala Harris is the national ringleader of abortion lawfare!_

**[That’s why I’m counting on your support for _Students for Life Action_ today – to help me spread the TRUTH about just how radical Kamala Harris is on abortion](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtdddc-duchtdja-y/).**

If you and I CAN’T get the truth out, every pro-lifer in the country could have a bullseye on their backs.

Let me explain . . .

In case you missed it, just a few weeks ago, our friends at the _Center for Medical Progress_ released a new round of undercover videos showing _Planned Parenthood_ executives discussing selling organs from babies they aborted.

In the videos, Tram Nguyen, RN – _Planned Parenthood_ Gulf Coast’s Vice President of Abortion Access – bragged about how she commits abortions to save the priciest body parts, stating:

_“I’m like, ‘Yeah, I have a leg for you!’ I’m like, oh s—t, if other people were to hear me, they’d be like, ‘You are f—king evil.”_
In another video, abortionist Dr. Ann Schutt-Aine bragged how she’ll _“pull off a leg, or two”_ to skirt the federal ban on partial-birth abortion.

These videos were recorded YEARS ago.

But they were banned from being released until now because of Kamala Harris.

You see, in 2015, the _Center for Medical Progress_ created a firestorm when it released undercover videos, recorded by my friend David Daleiden, showing _Planned Parenthood_ staffers:

*** _Exclaim, “It’s another boy_!”** as a “technician” picked through the remains of an aborted baby;
*** _Admit they alter abortions to salvage preborn baby parts_ ,** saying things like “I’m gonna basically crush below, I’m gonna crush above [the heart, lung, and liver], and I’m gonna see if I can get it all intact;”
*** _State that dead fully-formed, intact babies_** would be “just a matter of line items” for _Planned Parenthood_ workers to fulfill;
*** _Joke, “I want a Lamborghini_ ,”** with all the money they hope to make from the sale of freshly-aborted baby parts.
As Attorney General of California, Kamala Harris responded by going after _Planned Parenthood,_ right?

**WRONG!**

Kamala Harris’ response was to authorize the raid and seizure of the rest of the undercover videos, which a court order banned from being released until now.

Not only that, but David Daleiden was charged with EIGHT FELONIES for daring to expose the truth about _Planned Parenthood._

## **[>>> DONATE TO STOP THE ABORTION LOBBY’S TOTAL TAKEOVER OF D.C.<<<](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtdddc-duchtdja-j/)**
**Pro-Life Friend, it’s no coincidence that legal attacks on pro-lifers have skyrocketed since Kamala Harris became Vice President.**

Just consider how the Biden-Harris Department of Justice went after pro-life protester Paulette Harlow – a DYING grandmother. At her sentencing, the judge snickered, _“Make every effort to stay alive”_ while in jail.

I’d say this is heartless, but what do you expect from people who think killing babies is wonderful.

She is the pro-abortion, lawfare candidate for President.

And she will do whatever it takes to DESTROY the Pro-Life Movement and build on her radical pro-abortion record, which includes:

**>>> _Becoming the first Vice President in American history to visit an abortion facility_.** As she spoke to the press inside a building where innocent little boys and girls are slaughtered, Vice President Harris had the audacity to blast pro-life laws for being “immoral” – as if protecting innocent life is evil;
**>>> _Voting AGAINST the _Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act_ as a U.S. Senator_.** This bill would have simply required that babies who are born alive after a botched abortion receive proper medical care. But Kamala Harris would rather these babies simply be left to die screaming on cold hospital tables before their little bodies are trashed;
**>>> _Praising efforts to shut down Pregnancy Resource Centers_** to ensure _Planned Parenthood_ can commit as many abortions as possible and keep funneling profits into the campaigns of radical pro-abortion politicians; and
**>>> _Refusing to name a single abortion limit she’d support_** and supported Biden-Harris Administration efforts to impose late-term abortion on all 50 states in the country – all paid for by taxpayers.
## **[>>> DONATE TO STOP THE ABORTION LOBBY’S TOTAL TAKEOVER OF D.C.<<<](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtdddc-duchtdja-t/)**
Pro-Life Friend, this is as evil as evil gets.

If Kamala Harris gets elected, every pro-lifer will have a target on their back.

Including me.

Including you.

If you and I don’t send a message against this madness, I’m worried the great “defenders of Democracy” in the Biden-Harris Administration will start hurling you and me in jail – simply for being pro-life.

If that sounds unbelievable, the _University of Maryland’s_ START project – which is affiliated with the Department of Homeland Security – _listed Students for Life**as a terrorist group!**_

Not only that, but you may have seen a few weeks ago how the U.S. Army held a training session at Fort Liberty that labeled pro-life Americans, even those who simply have a pro-life license plate, to be potential domestic “terrorists”. . .

Pro-Life Friend, this is the ugly face behind the mask the media has put on Kamala Harris.

The American people need to see it.

They need to know what’s at stake.

**[If you agree, will you prayerfully consider making your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action_ of $100, $50, $25, or $10 as we fight to EXPOSE Kamala Harris](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtdddc-duchtdja-i/)?**

If we don’t, who will?

It’s time to act before the America you and I love is gone forever.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. – It’s no secret Kamala Harris will do anything in her power to stop pro-lifers at all costs, especially with her buddies at _Planned Parenthood_.

Now, she plans on using her possible presidential position of power to run point for the Abortion Lobby.

**[Will you stand with _Students for Life Action_ and help us fight back against the Abortion Goliath ahead of November](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtdddc-duchtdja-d/)?**

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.
---

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zisb3jv580083prs6v1259gn4rhugn7k3m58hio0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1chgm1o31c3h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zhdek6bru8ghjadkvphb42su90c7oefmksgggl3g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1chgm1o31c3h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zsepa3nub0gnbsiu5q6ss0tmmgpi5j88u156lqg0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1chgm1o31c3h2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: Before they're gone
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zcepmnh8627vqfgs1b7k4k6t61u98sucmvpavuj0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1chgm9o74c3h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zh5hghtfi8jdtg487hj5hpshjmjneufi3acqcd40_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1chgm9o74c3h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zirfdtvg2kncla555se7nk5f6ac3i9iufflve2g8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1chgm9o74c3h2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
P.S. The **“The Second World Wars”** DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. Plus, it makes a perfect gift for anyone who wants to know more about the Second World War. **[Reserve your copy now.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhfd21f96hbi891tigvul8hetqvco95r32f1f4po_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1chgm9o74c3h2bs)**

name: Hillsdale College via Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=009c84d12458458c80099b552e0325fe&_e=YZfez53m05PmULehr7pMDTqFQ2_BMmr04QLyxwvKvFh4EPE_8U7kpyzVx8v05MLmbAv63cQIvZv5O2VIhqdKnOisnZsb3TnGyhtD1ACPGq159y5jOk1-PtYO25wRlmHbuCymh4jOw_44SJjh8V9faPvaQGD4NVV9h4HkhyQyAVlg2JSAkvENC9b5ZhsDr-egeK6_qviJTuO9vnC68l0swDLY9JzQsR5da9l4wcgkYahiQaG-P4vcN7vXxjj_bixQ1UjzYuiQXofoCHwOsQWzMdatiRJr9b8Ver1Px6Akx8nCYca3jp9GnugEbFgWPDZH2E2yk4AWcC2GKH3xxPKpDH7rlhOKG-tXbJINaXeMUHMbW8FSxEyUNF9UbXBSFQGfGgpREIUAdAILI7Jgot_qahIp0w7Ver8uDi29ik8lLHL6XBJeMalSZkjj0WKvKk1n) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **" The Second World Wars."**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=009c84d12458458c80099b552e0325fe&_e=YZfez53m05PmULehr7pMDTqFQ2_BMmr04QLyxwvKvFh4EPE_8U7kpyzVx8v05MLmbAv63cQIvZv5O2VIhqdKnOisnZsb3TnGyhtD1ACPGq159y5jOk1-PtYO25wRlmHbuCymh4jOw_44SJjh8V9faPvaQGD4NVV9h4HkhyQyAVlg2JSAkvENC9b5ZhsDr-egeK6_qviJTuO9vnC68l0swDLY9JzQsR5da9l4wcgkYahiQaG-P4vcN7vXxjj_bixQ1UjzYuiQXofoCHwOsQWzMU4CxETSM-3GN6t9QxVgTuXm17B11S8HFuOD71H4fIYrvWd3YIAE7GuSoN3V789KAZic7YGwdSunZjF_io4kmybClTc90KEfa3eIc6GbY9SPY9D4ppM0EFfMyp2MK8wLQoSL3RKOEcL7KrVWd2W-aMtyTKPPPti4d8UWgpDTLMUH) If you'd like to secure a DVD set before they're all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here's a secure link to reserve your copy of **" The Second World Wars"** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=009c84d12458458c80099b552e0325fe&_e=YZfez53m05PmULehr7pMDTqFQ2_BMmr04QLyxwvKvFh4EPE_8U7kpyzVx8v05MLmbAv63cQIvZv5O2VIhqdKnOisnZsb3TnGyhtD1ACPGq159y5jOk1-PtYO25wRlmHbuCymh4jOw_44SJjh8V9faPvaQGD4NVV9h4HkhyQyAVlg2JSAkvENC9b5ZhsDr-egeK6_qviJTuO9vnC68l0swDLY9JzQsR5da9l4wcgkYahiQaG-P4vcN7vXxjj_bixQ1UjzYuiQXofoCHwOsQWzMRiu8ykq9qgudBKnmnrAs9k24f7_7wmzXJnaKpZxyQ2GHJ9y2HRh0fjZXYSZLPNbWRew2t1n0HCr0STq1PSc8aGCY5xqDf3XgqwPoADDBK-uCASEzCOdB1PGvULnpV7eFjGIdtoET9hdLFxSzhTs3-9KmEnv6uTUjHj9kWUPZv3J)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,

Because I know that your inbox is probably . . . Because I know that your inbox is probably crowded with so many political emails, emails about the state of our country and the numerous important elections that are happening right now.And more importantly, I know that you are busy with a life of your own, a family of your own, and daily trials and joys of your own. So, I hope you know that taking a minute out of your day to read about my critical battle to defeat Democrat Adam Schiff and fight for the future of California means the world to me. Fellow Patriot, I hope you’ll and stay up to date through election day. We have less than 3 months to go, and so much is at stake. If you care about the future of California and the fight to bring common sense leadership to our country’s most left-wing state like I do, the greatest thing you can do is pray for me and my election. And friend, in addition to your prayers, if you’re able, goes a long way towards helping me fight against Adam Schiff and the Democrat machine backing his campaign. ## Deadly Storm Strikes the Northeast
Severe storms hammered parts of Connecticut, New York, and New Jersey on Sunday, killing two as historic flooding damaged roads, bridges, and communities. [You can see storm damage here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1yhCAURp8GOxy4ImhBkcZu06Z0WLiuN8OKIzc6eftMfsq033eKM-ftNt8CZdoer-GJnpcyh8h04jxIUBLMbJrkF0TArkGvHRhttdN9s3o7ODCDwwSj7ezdwqA7AFDjHZXrNDTkQYFRAyitlDW2DS6aO_Zx7BVCF1AYhYm4HO17oY1XXPJnOfFoY3k22a_MexXdi4BJwHRdVxuZtkrpl_jeMPCKh4ApHEwxo4ApslxyKYm2h_z75VFCqjLmUjHJTCfKjz0Fxir1aK1Rtm_3dW8On_aLcqZqnTDq8QyUf1z4_zKnh68AAAD__7dzZcU).Heavy rainfall triggered [flash flooding](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFuhDAQheHTQGdkD8awhYs0dJs2JRrMAI6MvbJnQbl9ROp0v_Q1T-_rOT3RBx-3TzzI8pomdOxPmgYBUoCedL3YlQiorcmqHrQyqlddvdvFrTCYQfYa8WGGFkznjHOLWWfsuk7V3oIELQeQSkqjTYO90zN17tFJghap0pIWzyk338lH3mkNP-mk3Lh01MHuzK9StR8VjBWM13U1cXaRrnJ7BeOdNxDyTrmC0UemWEgUTvkoYkZmyiKmzDthYeHwfSudlEmsAcsu1pDS4uMmyns-KG93ZhdRmV4pqLNdXpcPwRfTV1puB_rwt47__-q08BsAAP__JgRvBw) in the tristate area where roads were turned into rivers, cars were submerged in fast-rising waters, and water rescues unfolded on Long Island and in Connecticut.Storms produced as much as [a foot of rain](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOqzAQAL8Guo3MYmMoXLwmXV57JVrMOvHJYGRvgvL3p1x99Uwxmq_bfKOY4n7_Txs7CXkmL_HF8wioAPWs29UFZuS-ZddZ1N3Q2c60DzeN1ixG-ykEZTtPZKgzyi6Iixn6JbTRoUKtRlSdUoMeLmS9Xtj4ySjGnrjRitcouVy-c9zlwSG984vLxeetTe4hctSm_9fgtcHrwflI_EENXhHOvPEOK9MKcQef9529RP8UoCBcYOG436GefAjQSW9Y3hBSzutJwqXC-iwfQUqEKiQMVJigSi5bhXGYrBn7trj1OGNKsQ620eq-UUy_cfL3qpfDnwAAAP__Vnxt6Q) on some parts of western Connecticut late Sunday and early Monday. ## Phil Donahue Dies at 88
Talk show host Phil Donahue, a daytime television legend, [died Sunday at age 88](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz71uwyAUQOGngQ0LrjE4A0MXb-na0eLnOtwKQ2TTWH37qp07n-Ho-7ivd0-F6uPd7-j61lYfO71wnQVIAXrVPLkNEXDk6JQFrYyyauLZ2TkEk8DOxoTJjD5KazCYm1Vy06OaOTmQoOUMUklptBm8jTrgFG-TRBg9Mi0xUW_H8Nmo9oxb-W4vPIbYdl5c7v15svGNwcJgua5rqCH-NgZLDVFQPSnhwWB5ZioiterzF4pEeIqLNhS7P0oTPbfdn_xw6XlRKXQay7R87J7K36j_z345-AkAAP___xFamg), surrounded by family, including his wife, actress Marlo Thomas. Donahue gained fame in the 1970s and '80s for [pioneering a new type](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu6zAMAL_G3hxQJC05g4a3ZMtbOxqMRMUqFMtwVAf9-yKdOx5uOOA-rvNVcsnr_b881LdUZwktHzpPA8KAPHMffVJFpV69ccjGGmfGfvGTiA1kA0h0iQGTOJkCGboRcQraZ4-ADBOCAbBsT-IC33QM5xEUSbRj0Jhb3U-fNa9t0VS-66H7KdRHX_zS2vbs6F-Hlw4vsq36er7VG_aWQ9EOL9uSyxDrKsuXDlElDkTuRpZgRJbRWQYXjDHnNJ4hmhi5333cXrmU_LSuY7g_JJffZPt7wOHxJwAA__9ok1sA) of daytime show that tackled hot-button issues and encouraged interaction between Donahue and audience members, particularly resonating with female viewers."The Phil Donahue Show," which launched in Dayton, Ohio, in 1967, ran in syndication for 26 years, earning 20 Emmy Awards and a Presidential Medal of Freedom for Donahue. View his [life in pictures here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DHPpCAQxvFPgx0GRwQtKK6h22uvNLMyrFxQDM5q9ttf9uq3f57kl_-fx_zAlNP--o0bOY5lxoXTRfMoQUnQs26Ci0RAfUOus6A709luaFYHaOE5WBP6aQrPCHaIYDujrAETJxub5ECBViOoTimjTYt20U8almlQBD2S0IpC4lLbvyXtvFLMn3JRbZeyNdmtzMcp-l8CvAB_33f7PpFLwM93IMAfaeF3JfnCnKl-BHjamSpj2jfaWYDnS4D_KgR4NQrw3fT9rSnLUHZc3yRziiRxD3LBSlTlsRYupwBv9ThYNWqlrADfVBeOO-WcTmOFVq8NU_4P5Z-zXQ7-BQAA__-glW0h)

Because I know that your inbox is probably . . . So, I hope you know that taking a minute out of your day to read about my critical battle to defeat Democrat Adam Schiff and fight for the future of California means the world to me. Fellow Patriot, I hope you’ll and stay up to date through election day. We have less than 3 months to go, and so much is at stake. If you care about the future of California and the fight to bring common sense leadership to our country’s most left-wing state like I do, the greatest thing you can do is pray for me and my election. And friend, in addition to your prayers, if you’re able, goes a long way towards helping me fight against Adam Schiff and the Democrat machine backing his campaign. name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: Before they're gone
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/8gc5EYyNgsoS9NIKx6dSSA~~/AARclAA~~~) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/8gc5EYyNgsoS9NIKx6dSSA~~/AARclAA~~~) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/8gc5EYyNgsoS9NIKx6dSSA~~/AARclAA~~~)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
P.S. The **“The Second World Wars”** DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. Plus, it makes a perfect gift for anyone who wants to know more about the Second World War. **[Reserve your copy now.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/8gc5EYyNgsoS9NIKx6dSSA~~/AARclAA~~~)**

## USS Kingsville To Be Commissioned Saturday
The USS _Kingsville_(LCS-36), the Navy's newest littoral combat ship, arrived in Corpus Christi this past weekend, ahead of its [commissioning this Saturday](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGSpCAQQL8GM6agaREDgkvM9tILp1DasWtRLGB09--v9vJLXvKSV-_Px_MjcOLj9Tvs5NvXmp9haXzR00lQEvCJXfSziqPuyOsBUPe2B91tPs7RBj0gDauza0ALrkcDTlt0Mw6qYw8KUDlQWvXW4APBjZbMaqONs4okUFHklsujbdToK9Q1feeLymPJe5f81tpZhfklYBIw3ff9-GTmdv1oAVMojZdEAqaD7ipgWvK-vw9u3wKmd63yk49XvTglkqEUvqjKlmXbSJ65NJlXueRyvqtctsK1sYCpV0YCGq00WKl1sBJ_MBqyEvpxNNAjzMp1xcfz5pS42kGgeu2B07_s9p-Ll4e_AQAA___uh3I4). The Kingsville is the [only active combat ship](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOpiAUhZ8GO_7AFRktKLaxm223NAhXuRkUA_w6vv3GzbZTnnw5Jyffn8_p01Kkff1tNzT1e0mTdZVOnHoOgoOaVOPNLPwgGzTyA5TsdAeyCUb3shugB6W6ocduUCicRuta2cp2GLAhAwKU6EFI0elWvRT0g8Z20V77WXhkSqCnmvKrBqz4bcsS73Rifrm0NdGEWo_C2l8MRgbjdV2vr0ylng9mMO54FQZjTM5G_j_Qzu_0znxHWsOcckjJMxhdyse7cBeePjEYZ3tzm9E-jOrNQ4q-cIcZt7TffEmZ7_a8y7OLpfIS6ODvUvgX7Ws5KUZssvHHRTFS0R9MiXWzFP89rz-IPA38DQAA__-ij3l2) named after a Texas city, honoring the rich history of Naval Air Station Kingsville, where Navy pilots have trained since 1942. The ship, designed for [coastal operations](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0zzFv8yAQgOFfA1us43wGZ2D4Fm_51o4WGLBPxSEyxE3-fdXu3V-90vNxm2-OM9_X_26Ptr1Smd3S-IzzeEG4IM0kg_UQrkpGqwySGvSASm6WgjGG3AjeIPWuT8m7AQiU1sHrwUi2CEgwIigYdE8d4XjVsU866OAhREEQA7dydG2LLb5cTfldznh0S9lltltrjyr6fwIngdOz1m7h9i7pk-9rPTnn-BMKnJwvzyZwkocNjy_Omas2gmDdHeffWfvDdlr8DgAA__8lw1FP), was built by Austal USA in Mobile, Alabama. It is equipped with a helipad, a large-caliber gun, and a missile launcher.
## Central Texas Hit with 16th Boil Water Notice in 2 Years
About 20,000 customers of a Central Texas water supplier have been under a [boil water notice](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuhSAYhZ8GNwz8IurA0IXtdu1oQH695CIYoVd9-8ama7eTfCcnJ9_XY3wYH3xcPs2KqpxzGs1U_BvHngKjIEZROWWZG3iFincgeCtb4NVTsW7oTdMjGGcBmbBSTmziYIemw7ZtKq-AgWA9MM5a2YhaQD9IbGbppLPMIREMnS9pr8sTC54mz-FKb9zrKa1VUM9StkyaDwKagD6Oo34d5bwhAX1vE9CsJ6D5QEC_cN0i7vQwBXeav7ctXDSbK9MUl-TjQm3y4Q_HVPyE9PAh3JlapMHPBR018Sp-RZpTigR0tSu33TWfZUcEW1bjw--_8o-ut4KfAAAA__8Jtm3q) since last Wednesday--the sixteenth in the last two years--and there's no word from the company on when it will be lifted. Last week, the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality found that chlorine levels in the water [were too low](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LFugzAQxvGnMZuROYwhg4cubOnaETn4SE6xTWpfIXn7ikgdO5_up7--r_N0dhQoXT9dRMvPZZ3czLThNEhQEvSkK28vyp-aCm3Tg24600FT3aw3nTOD0-hwWFw796cG53YG7BUs3XKpyIICrQZQjepMq2sNw8lguxhv_EV5FFqhJ15zzTdkfLqyhNe6Ya7nNVbB3pgfRbQfAkYB477v9X3n53EUMB62gFENAsamEzC-ATmvMVIptCaJaaO8Rkzsgvz-cYH4JRkLF7k7xizvGB8Js3SRvMxYyGPig0gz5lTkkfL3KGCssvWPnUKgYnqh1TU6Cu9U_me5zcJvAAAA__9zyHQh), triggering the boil water notice and prompting the Kempner Water Supply Corporation to announce a system purge scheduled for next Monday. The aging infrastructure in the region is a contributing factor. Kempner Mayor John Wilkerson [invited representatives](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLuSrCAYhJ8GMywExktAcBKzOemGFsKv_jUIFuDt7bdmazbcsPurDvr7eg5PjQ79_F-voPI1hUGbjAcMLeWMcjnIwqqR2a4qQFUNl9WjfvCqWFTXGtGKzmo5SjHyrtUNq6dJ2sY2QrSmQMUZl6zlrGKPWshS8rarQUy1re3ILBDJwGIOscwLZLh0mtwdDoilCWvh1JLzloj4R3hPeH-eZ_m6ruMNCe89nInw3gWjHf0E9PQOe6QecF7GEJcQLOH9C9bNQ6SrvkOk6A_MkOhve-oMkaZ929xNc6AerkwN5puasHuDjq4AGf38hhaT2VP6jDClHVIRld1OdA5T3RDJ5lWj-7mQ_zB6KP4dAAD__2v8fpw) from the company to attend a public hearing next week, but they declined.
## Texas Cities Among 'Buggiest' in U.S.
Texas metros are dominating the list of ["buggiest" U.S. cities in 2024](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOszAQhJ8GOqP1YgwuXPxNuvztlWixF7DOhAhvuNzbn5LiuitHM9J8-j6u45VSTrflP23s5TnvIwVJJ4-DQlBoRlNHP0F0umavezS6sx3qevWOSXcw90SAHWrUjjqegtVIQx_CUCePgAYGBA2dbU1jcHCW29lGGyeIXBngmGQ_GllZ-Ellzt_7yUcT9q3OfhW5l6r9V-GlwsuU96WR9bFNQuHzNanw8pvVwSdTLkpWVq9fNT2WJXERFZIkLird3t1DFUUuRnCtmx209eHj_SvlnIrtKwPLRim_AeQPH6fHnwAAAP__yXtixQ), with Dallas, Houston, and Austin claiming three of the top six spots, according to a report by Thumbtack. Dallas ranks third with a 7.7% year-over-year increase in pest control requests, while [Houston places fifth](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvwyAUhH8N3rDwC8ZmYOjClq4dLQwPG4WYyLzE6b-vknbt_H26O93XeTq7lNO2fLorGnrGMjlP6YHTyEFwkJNsgplF0F2DphtAdr3qoWtWI1E57QY5qOCdlLNWUXsfIepeooiqSQYESDGC6ESvTrKVMGqFp6iCCrMIyKTAkKjsLa1I-HQ15u_ywL315dpksxLdKjt9MLAM7HEcrc_JX2At90ple1kM7IZHZWBz8S4zsK9OBlaMDGynGdg_m-9uu1SeNk7lxnsey87n-7IkrMR9ooS_cEV-r2_6SuLO-7KHtC2cCg-OHAPb7CbcjpRzqmpgUixXl_J7M_1z4cPATwAAAP__Ih9zmA) with an 8% uptick. Atlanta retained its No. 1 position for the second consecutive year. The report, based on millions of home project requests nationwide, indicates a significant rise in demand for pest control services across major U.S. markets. With 2024 projected to be the hottest summer on record, battling bugs in Texas is expected to be particularly challenging.

It is with great pride that I endorse Judson Sapp for Florida State Representative in District 20.

The citizens of Clay, Marion, Putnam, and St. Johns Counties can be assured that Judson Sapp is an America First patriot as well as an early and loyal supporter of President Donald Trump.

Judson Sapp is a proven pro-life, pro-gun, pro-Trump conservative who will fight for the people, not special interests.

As a man who has dedicated his life to our Nation, I commend Judson Sapp for his willingness to serve the people of his district and for his courage to stand firm on principle.

I urge all citizens of Florida’s 20th State House District to vote for Judson Sapp for State Representative in tomorrow's Republican Primary.

-General Michael Flynn_

**Judson**

name: Hillsdale College via Old Glory Today
subject: Before they're gone
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Old Glory Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/_jDBPXcYN3NwDyBlMSls4A~~/AARclAA~~~) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/_jDBPXcYN3NwDyBlMSls4A~~/AARclAA~~~) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/_jDBPXcYN3NwDyBlMSls4A~~/AARclAA~~~)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
P.S. The **“The Second World Wars”** DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. Plus, it makes a perfect gift for anyone who wants to know more about the Second World War. **[Reserve your copy now.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/_jDBPXcYN3NwDyBlMSls4A~~/AARclAA~~~)**

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 8/20/2024
body:
Colorado’s Property Tax Crisis: The Partisan Divide Driving Colorado’s Housing Affordability Crisis
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi everyone,
Stay tuned today as we'll be releasing lots of #DNC content via the website and social media. Lots to discuss to keep you in the know. Also, Dan Caplis and I talked all about it on last night's segment. [Check it out here!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, August 20, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Colorado’s Property Tax Crisis: The Partisan Divide Driving Colorado’s Housing Affordability Crisis](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JAMES CONSTAS, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Homeowners across Colorado with mortgages are opening their annual escrow analyses and facing a shocking reality. I am one of them.
To my dismay, I discovered my mortgage will increase by a staggering $1,000 per month. This 54% surge in my monthly payment was driven by soaring property taxes and an even more exorbitant rise in homeowner’s insurance premiums. Astonishingly, I now pay more towards taxes and insurance than towards the principal and interest on the property!
Outraged, I shared my escrow analysis on X (formerly known as Twitter), where it garnered 887 likes, 263 retweets, and over 24,000 views in just 24 hours, clearly striking a chord. The 72 comments came from fellow homeowners sharing their fiscal misery and a few misguided apologists underscores the budget-busting pain being experienced by Colorado homeowners, which will be passed on to renters eventually.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Livestock producers write letter again asking CPW, Polis to kill depredating wolves](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [KDVR](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado livestock producers are urging Colorado Parks and Wildlife (CPW) to allow lethal control of wolves in Grand and Jackson counties due to ongoing livestock losses.
* The request follows multiple wolf attacks on cattle and sheep, with producers arguing that non-lethal deterrents have been ineffective against the predators accustomed to human presence.
* Despite the concerns raised by livestock producers, CPW continues to promote non-lethal management techniques, emphasizing collaboration and education in its approach to wolf-livestock conflicts.
* CPW has not approved the lethal removal of wolves, citing ongoing conservation and management efforts, including monitoring the newly formed “Copper Creek Pack” which includes recently confirmed pups.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Democratic Party platform released Sunday calls for re-electing Joe Biden](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BREITBART](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Democratic Party platform supports the reelection of President Joe Biden and aims to complete his administration's agenda.
* The platform begins with a land acknowledgment and criticizes the policies of settler colonialism, particularly targeting American and Israeli policies.
* Significant economic proposals from Vice President Kamala Harris, such as a taxpayer-funded down payment aid and a child tax credit, are omitted from the platform.
* It defends gender-affirming healthcare for transgender youth and criticizes Republican resistance to Biden’s comprehensive immigration reforms.
* The platform supports ongoing opposition to Russia’s actions in Ukraine and praises Biden's withdrawal from Afghanistan, omitting the negative aftermath.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Budget watchdog: Harris’ economic plan would add over $1.7T to national debt](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX BUSINESS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Kamala Harris' economic plan is projected to add $1.7 trillion to the U.S. national debt over ten years, as analyzed by the Committee for a Responsible Federal Budget (CRFB).
* The agenda includes expanding the Child Tax Credit and Earned Income Tax Credit, extending Affordable Care Act subsidies, and introducing a $25,000 tax credit for first-time homebuyers.
* The total cost of the new spending and tax credits is estimated at about $1.95 trillion, offset by $250 billion from lower prescription drug costs. The most costly measure, expanding the Child Tax Credit would increase the deficit by $1.1 trillion over ten years relative to current policies.
* The plan hints at funding these expenditures by increasing taxes on the wealthiest Americans and largest corporations, aiming to balance major investments with fiscal responsibility.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Jared Polis appoints Murphy Robinson to Colorado’s wildlife commission](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Murphy Robinson, previously Denver's deputy mayor and public safety chief, has been appointed to Colorado's wildlife commission by Governor Jared Polis. He will represent sportspersons, focusing on the stewardship and enjoyment of Colorado's parks and wildlife.
* His appointment coincides with tensions over the recent reintroduction of wolves, which has strained relations between ranchers and state officials. Alongside Robinson, Tai Jacober was appointed to represent agricultural producers.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Ten vehicles have crashed into stores since late March in Colorado Springs](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS 11 KKTV](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Since late March, 10 stores across Colorado Springs have been hit by vehicles in a series of crimes where suspects drove cars into the storefronts to steal merchandise.
* The incidents escalated in frequency from May, targeting a variety of businesses including smoke shops, clothing stores, and gun stores, with some criminals successfully stealing items such as rifles and handguns.
* The most recent incident occurred on August 19, when suspects drove an SUV into a smoke shop, with ongoing investigations to determine the extent of the theft.

| Dear Peter,

Recently, we asked for your input on what news matters most to you and what fuels your commitment to the global fight for reproductive rights. Your voices were clear: [**Reproductive rights are human rights.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91151792/492914315/-967261238?sourceid=1149762&utm_campaign=25emcfd-0801aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=project2025&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNjJmZDUxNy1mNTVlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9-ng-Yu2xOjMQuUGW3ww1xRyqemYHkmpC7mi5oynR5s=&emci=f1b4d038-725e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=262fd517-f55e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=954237)

Unfortunately, we face powerful forces determined to strip away our rights—few more dystopian than **Project 2025,** a blueprint by anti-abortion extremists to dismantle our fundamental freedoms. This fight isn't just about abortion; it’s about defending our right to fully participate in public and private life. We're fighting to protect our future, and we need you with us. **Can we count on you?** | | [**YES**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91151798/492914326/-967261238?sourceid=1149762&utm_campaign=25emcfd-0801aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=project2025&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNjJmZDUxNy1mNTVlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9-ng-Yu2xOjMQuUGW3ww1xRyqemYHkmpC7mi5oynR5s=&emci=f1b4d038-725e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=262fd517-f55e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=954237 "YES")

[**Now more than ever, we need Congress to act and enshrine the federal right to abortion for every person.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91151814/492914339/-967261238?sourceid=1149762&utm_campaign=25emcfd-0801aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=project2025&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNjJmZDUxNy1mNTVlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9-ng-Yu2xOjMQuUGW3ww1xRyqemYHkmpC7mi5oynR5s=&emci=f1b4d038-725e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=262fd517-f55e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=954237)

Friend – I’ve worked in politics for half a century, so believe me when I tell you: **Democrats are in BIG trouble.**

The 2024 Senate map is the toughest one I’ve ever seen. Our razor-thin majority is hanging on by a single thread, and there’s no question that GOP extremists will use every trick up their sleeves to snatch back power.

subject: It only takes $5

Peter, We’ll be brief - Donald Trump has endorsed our opponent Max Miller. Miller was a White House and Trump campaign aide before he ran for Congress, and he’s good buddies with Trump. We need your help fighting back against Donald Trump and giving Matthew the best possible shot on November 5. **We need to make concrete investments in our communities and our future. Unlike Max Miller, Matthew is committed to:** 🏗 Weeding out corruption in our government. 💼 Creating jobs for all Ohioans, especially young people. 💰 Lowering inflation and housing costs so everyone can afford to live comfortably. 🏥 Codifying access to abortion federally. Our time is now. We can put money back in people’s pockets, which means more food in the fridge, more bills paid on time, and more cash flow in our communities. We need to come together to build that bright future.
That starts by electing leaders who have our best interests at heart. Leaders like Matthew Diemer. subject: MassGOP Calls on Acting Governor Bill Galvin to Unveil Concealed Details of $1 Billion Migrant Crisis Spending and Associated Safety Concerns

| | | | |

---
| MassGOP Calls on Acting Governor Bill Galvin to Unveil Concealed Details of $1 Billion Migrant Crisis Spending and Associated Safety Concerns
---
---
|
Boston, MA- As the Healey-Driscoll Administration attends the Democratic National Convention in Chicago, the details surrounding taxpayer-funded spending on the migrant crisis remain deliberately concealed from the public.
Over the past two years, nearly 8,000 migrant families have been housed in facilities that are on track to cost taxpayers over $1 billion in FY 2024, yet the appropriation of this enormous sum remains shrouded in mystery.
The Healey-Driscoll Administration has kept vital information from the people of the Commonwealth, including the identities of the vendors involved and the amounts they are being paid. Investigative journalists have uncovered instances like a hotel in Methuen charging the state $165 per night, despite local health inspectors documenting 330 violations.
Records indicate that the providers managing these taxpayer-funded shelters have reported approximately 600 "serious incidents," many requiring police, fire, or medical intervention. The details of these cases remain redacted. The only publicly known case involved an alleged rape of a minor, revealed not by the Administration but by the Rockland police department. Beyond that, the residents of the Commonwealth remain in the dark.
The lack of transparency is staggering, and the Healey-Driscoll Administration has refused to provide further information to the public. Given this refusal to disclose crucial details regarding spending and safety risks, the Massachusetts Republican Party calls on Secretary Bill Galvin, in his role as Acting Governor, to release the unredacted documentation concerning the expenditures on the emergency housing program and the safety incidents associated with the state shelter system. The public deserves nothing less.
Massachusetts Republican Party Chair Amy Carnevale released the following statement, "As Acting Governor, Secretary Galvin holds a rare and critical opportunity to do something the Healey-Driscoll Administration has refused: to inform the residents of the Commonwealth about the allocation of over $1 billion in taxpayer funds for the emergency shelter program. For nearly 30 years, Bill Galvin has served as Secretary of the Commonwealth in a bipartisan capacity. We now call upon him to exercise his authority as Acting Governor and disclose where these taxpayer dollars are being spent, identify the vendors receiving this funding, and provide transparency on the over 600 'serious incidents' reported in taxpayer-funded shelters. It is his duty to ensure accountability and transparency in the use of public funds."

clean_body: | | | Peter -- When I take the stage at the Democratic National Convention later, I have only one goal: to introduce the world to the Kamala that I know. She’s a lifelong advocate for justice. She’s a strong, smart prosecutor who has a record of standing up to powerful interests. She’s a partner to President Biden and has worked alongside him to achieve a historic record of accomplishment. She’s a devoted wife, an incredible cook, and my favorite person in the world. I can’t think of anyone more qualified to lead our country in building a brighter, more hopeful future where everyone has a chance to not just get by, but to get ahead. body:

# Shape the Future
---
[](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=1fd5a30b5e&e=0f456155ff)
| We’re at a pivotal moment in our nation’s history. Voting for Kamala Harris and Tim Walz is critical—but it’s not enough. To truly make the change we need, we must also elect leaders in Congress who will work with Kamala to deliver on the promises that matter most to us.

**As Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez put it last night:**
---
| _“We cannot send Kamala and Tim to the White House alone. We must also elect strong Democratic majorities in the House and in the Senate so that we can deliver on the agenda for the people.”_
---
| **Here’s why your vote for Patti Hewitt matters:**
---
|
* **Affordable Healthcare:** Kamala Harris wants to expand healthcare access, but she can’t do it without a Congress that will pass the necessary laws. **Patti Hewitt** will fight to make sure that happens.

* **Economic Security:** From raising the minimum wage to ensuring equal pay for equal work, Kamala’s vision for a fair economy needs a Democratic majority in Congress. **Patti will be that vote.**

* **Climate Action:** Tackling climate change requires bold action, and Kamala’s plan demands Congressional support. **Patti is committed** to pushing forward the policies that will protect our planet for future generations.

---
| Your vote for **Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Patti Hewitt** is a vote for a better future. It’s about more than just one leader; it’s about electing a team that can turn our hopes into reality.

**What can you do?**
---
|
* **Share:** Forward this email to friends, family, and neighbors who may not realize how crucial their vote is.

* [**Get Involved:**](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=9bb15a616d&e=0f456155ff) Join us in reaching out to others. Together, we can ensure that everyone understands what’s at stake.

* [**Donate:**](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=a7b7fc9574&e=0f456155ff) Your financial support can make all the difference. By contributing to Patti Hewitt’s campaign, you’re helping to fund the outreach, ads, and resources needed to ensure victory.

---
| This is about building the future we want for our families, our communities, and our country. **Let’s make sure that when we wake up on November 6th, we know we did everything we could to secure a brighter tomorrow.**

Thank you for your commitment to this cause.

---

Butch Ware’s Epic First VP Speech

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=resend_vp_speech_ba&n=1)

---
Peter,

If you missed Butch Ware’s speech at the VP announcement rally, we got you. Even if you did see it, it is well worth another watch:

---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ba?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=resend_vp_speech_ba&n=3 "WATCH NOW") [WATCH NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ba?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=resend_vp_speech_ba&n=3)
---
Jill is a fighter, as we all know, and she found someone who is ready to fight alongside her in this historic moment. Not only is Butch in it to win it, he also has a vision for the future of the Green Party. He wants to help grow the party to be a solid vehicle for challenging empire and oligarchy. Team Jill Stein couldn’t have asked for a better Vice Presidential Candidate to take the White House, end the genocide in Gaza, and work for a society free of injustice. But even as we celebrate Butch joining our team, we can’t lose sight of the urgent need to gain ballot access in 5 remaining states. Remember, having Stein/Ware on the ballot is the first step to winning the White House, and, just as importantly, giving people an anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate emergency alternative in November. The final 5 states represent 11,445,000 voters. The deadline for collecting signatures in these states is coming up fast. body:
It’s been close race after close race, with some even coming down to a difference of just a few thousand votes.
#

Friend — We’re not exaggerating when we say that Arizona will come down to the wire this election.
Just look at the last few years. It’s been close race after close race, with some even coming down to a difference of just a few thousand votes.
When Joe Biden won Arizona in 2020, it was only the second time a Democratic presidential candidate has won the state in the last **76 years.**
There’s no path to victory for the GOP if they lose here. That’s why they’re spending big in Arizona to boost MAGA candidates.
So when the final votes are counted this November, it’s going to be close. There’s no doubt.
And it’s not just the race for the White House either. Ruben Gallego’s race will decide which party controls the Senate. And Arizona has two House seats in crucial swing districts too.
Mark, Gabby, and his team are doing everything they can to help excite voters and get more Arizonans out to the polls in November, but they can’t do it alone.

name: Anika Page
subject: Fall Speaker Series Kickoff with Shad White
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/myvisionforms-11572979?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Good morning Friend,

We are kicking off our fall Speaker Series with none other than Mississippi’s State Auditor, Shad White, for an exclusive discussion on some of the most pressing issues facing our state, on September 19th at the Country Club of Jackson.
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=56a03899bc&e=5703353baa)
---
_Click above to purchase your tickets!_
| **Discover "The Mississippi Swindle" - **Shad White will share insights from his new book, uncovering shocking stories of financial mismanagement and corruption in Mississippi. This is a must-read for anyone passionate about transparency and accountability in our state,

**Addressing K-12 Administrative Waste -** Our education system is plagued with inefficiencies. Shad will break down where the waste is happening and how we can redirect those resources to benefit our students and teachers directly.

**The Role of DEI in Public Universities -** Dive into a critical analysis of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion programs in our public universities. How are these initiatives affecting academic standards and campus culture? This event isn’t just about listening—it’s about engaging in meaningful dialogue and finding solutions. Whether you're a concerned parent, an educator, or simply someone who cares about the future of Mississippi, your voice matters. **RSVP[here](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=e831dce2b0&e=5703353baa) **to reserve your spot and join us for this important conversation.

As always, I am looking forward to seeing you there, see you soon!
---
| |
---
Warmest wishes,

Anika Page
Director of Operations

Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=082024_1&amount=25]
MPR: ‘Minnesota Voting Rights Act’ nears governor’s signature after state Senate approval [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=082024_1&amount=25]
Team: Amidst all the continuous fights over our right to vote lately we cannot lose sight of our successes -- Minnesota passed a new state Voting Rights Act that will expand voting rights. This law:
➜ Guarantees voters the right to sue if they face vote suppression or vote dilution.
➜ Guarantees in state law protections previously afforded under the 1965 federal Voting Rights Act.
➜ Uses a person’s address prior to incarceration for setting voting maps, rather than counting their residence in the region where they are incarcerated.
➜ Sharpens a state law that makes it a crime to make and share distorted images and videos intended to influence an election.
Remember: The recent 8th Federal Circuit Court ruling is one of the most dangerous anti-voter rulings we’ve seen in years . In the eight states impacted by the ruling, voters and voting rights organizations can no longer sue to overturn unjust laws under the Voting Rights Act.
This new law in Minnesota restores those protections and codifies them in state law, regardless of how the Supreme Court eventually rules.
Team: We need to expand this progress from Minnesota to other states around the country. Pitch in $25 or whatever you can today to defend the right to vote and support our work to pass critical pro-voter legislation nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=082024_1&amount=25]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

The original Voting Rights Act is one of the most important laws ever passed in American history and a critical protection against discrimination in our democracy. With the courts dismantling it piece by piece, we need states to act and protect our right to vote.
We're not the only ones who see it this way. Michael Pernick, voting rights attorney of the NAACP Legal Defense and Educational Fund, said this: “ As Black voters face the greatest assault on voting rights since Jim Crow, Minnesota is embracing the opportunity to build on its progress in advancing the freedom to vote and join the growing list of states protecting voters against unequal access to the ballot. ”
Governors and state legislatures can act to help solve the voting rights crisis . It's up to us to make sure they do their jobs.
Team, we need to spread laws like this around the country like wildfire, from Arizona to Nevada to Georgia. Pitch in $25 or whatever you can today to help expand ballot access and make every vote count nationwide! >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=082024_1&amount=25]

clean_body: In an ultra-competitive presidential election year, our candidates are competing for press, volunteers, ad space, and donors against races at the top of the ticket. | | | | | ---|--- President Obama said it best: State legislators make decisions that impact your life the most – from the roads you drive on, to the lessons taught in our classrooms. It’s these leaders who will have the most direct effect on communities like yours. But state legislative campaigns are constantly overlooked and underfunded. name: Gabby Giffords
subject: “A despicable day in the Senate” - Joe Biden
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
On April 17, 2013, I was sitting in then-Vice President Joe Biden's ceremonial office in the Capitol when the United States Senate blocked a bipartisan bill to close the loopholes that let people buy guns without a background check.
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug24.hBGz9O&refcode=em240820-1-BL&t=1&akid=8747%2E3935704%2E9OlTTQ)
---
Friends -
On April 17, 2013, I was sitting in then Vice President Joe Biden's ceremonial office in the Capitol as I watched the United States Senate block a bipartisan bill to close the loopholes that let dangerous people buy guns without a background check.
Shortly after the vote ended, the Vice President told me it was "a despicable day in the Senate," and invited me to join him and President Obama at the White House. In the motorcade up Pennsylvania Avenue, the Vice President told me our country always rejects extreme views in the end, and that common sense gun violence prevention legislation would pass eventually—that it was not a question of if, but when.
In the past three and a half years, President Biden has done more for gun safety than **_any_** other president in history. Signing the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act into law. Creating the White House Office of Gun Violence Prevention. Codifying ATF regulations on ghost guns and bump stocks. Historic funding for community violence intervention programs. The list goes on.
Even though we have made so much progress in the movement for gun safety under President Biden’s leadership, we are still waiting for Congress to pass universal background checks.
I know that Vice President Kamala Harris is the candidate who can finish the job. But we also need to elect a Congress who will help her get this done.
[**So please, will you make a $3 contribution to help us elect Vice President Kamala Harris, hold our slim gun safety majority in the US Senate, and take back the House of Representatives?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug24.hBGz9O&refcode=em240820-1-BL&t=2&akid=8747%2E3935704%2E9OlTTQ)

clean_body: On April 17, 2013, I was sitting in then-Vice President Joe Biden's ceremonial office in the Capitol when the United States Senate blocked a bipartisan bill to close the loopholes that let people buy guns without a background check. Friends - On April 17, 2013, I was sitting in then Vice President Joe Biden's ceremonial office in the Capitol as I watched the United States Senate block a bipartisan bill to close the loopholes that let dangerous people buy guns without a background check. Shortly after the vote ended, the Vice President told me it was "a despicable day in the Senate," and invited me to join him and President Obama at the White House. In the motorcade up Pennsylvania Avenue, the Vice President told me our country always rejects extreme views in the end, and that common sense gun violence prevention legislation would pass eventually—that it was not a question of if, but when. In the past three and a half years, President Biden has done more for gun safety than any other president in history. Signing the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act into law. Creating the White House Office of Gun Violence Prevention. Codifying ATF regulations on ghost guns and bump stocks. Historic funding for community violence intervention programs. The list goes on. Even though we have made so much progress in the movement for gun safety under President Biden’s leadership, we are still waiting for Congress to pass universal background checks. I know that Vice President Kamala Harris is the candidate who can finish the job. But we also need to elect a Congress who will help her get this done. ------------------------------------------------------------

** Primary Update
------------------------------------------------------------

According to Washington State law, county auditors must certify their election results TODAY, August 20, and Secretary of State Steve Hobbs must certify by this Friday.

We anticipate that these results will confirm what the preliminary counts show: Carmela Conroy will be competing in the general election to represent Eastern Washington in Congress.

Thanks to tens of thousands of voters, thousands of donors, dozens of volunteers and event organizers, and a few political professionals, we are within striking range of a well-known Republican politician with some deep-pocket sponsors. We know what to do.

In the two weeks since Primary Election ballots were due, we have visited with excited neighbors in Pend Oreille County, Spokane County, and Whitman County and heard from suppporters across the district. The soon-to-be top of the Democratic ticket is dynamic and positive and for the people. We are fired up, and we are in it to win it. LET’S GO!

body:
“hot legal garbage”
|

Day 1 of the DNC did not disappoint on domestic policy and issues, and could not have been more disappointing on foreign policy. We have a lot to cover so let's dive in. As a quick reminder, your support makes my advocacy possible. So, if you are in a position to invest a cup of coffee a month, [please do subscribe](https://substack.com/redirect/7759fdbf-57de-4d4e-ae51-941eb7798a9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)! **Let 's Address This.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8092573c-5cef-480c-9938-15b8833a071b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

The energy on Day 1 at the DNC was palpable. I appreciated that while the RNC handed out "MASS DEPORTATION NOW" signs, the DNC handed out simple but effective "USA" signs. The convention kicked off by recognizing the critical role of Black Americans throughout American history and particularly in the 20th century. Reverend Jesse Jackson was honored on stage, as were the names of Fannie Lou Hamer, Shirley Chisolm, Harold Washington, and many more icons.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c710b6c1-2ed7-4220-aec4-2e29b55b7d80?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Reverend Jesse Jackson honored on stage at the start of the DNC
Vice President Kamala Harris made a surprise entrance to the stage, a pre-cursor to her formal DNC nomination acceptance speech on Thursday. She stuck to her stump speech remarks that "when we fight, we win," and quickly departed to sit with other attendees as the DNC continued. Minnesota Lt. Governor Peggy Flanagan emceed much of the evening, notable also because once Governor Walz is elected Vice President, LG Flanagan will be the first female Native American governor in US history.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/22aa6a7f-c26f-4e4a-b036-2567b89b7b9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The most significant mention of Project 2025 came from Michigan State Senator Mallory McMorrow, who brought the entire fascist manifesto as a prop with her on stage. Her poise and delivery were excellent, and most importantly, her message was received loud and clear--Project 2025 is a brazen, unapologetic, undemocratic, unhinged attempt by the MAGA Republicans to permanently instal Donald Trump as a dictator. And we cannot underestimate how massive a threat it is to our democracy. If you haven't already read my detailed overview of Project 2025, [you can read it here with additional articles linked](https://substack.com/redirect/0cbd5d21-97ec-4b1d-b4a7-4ce7bb2420d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Unsurprisingly, most every speaker made the clear contrast between Trump and Harris, and did not mince words.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c199cbf8-90b9-441c-87e9-f6b92c4742b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Michigan state Sen. Mallory McMorrow, D-Royal Oak, speaks at the DNC.
New York Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez delivered what is being recognized as one of the most powerful speeches of the evening. Rep AOC grilled Donald Trump as a "two bit union buster" and contrasted him with Kamala Harris, "a woman who fights every day for us." Rep AOC was also the first to mention the words "ceasefire" and "Palestine" in her remarks. More on this later.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8ab9443e-0f22-4cfd-8742-20b3100b72aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Nine time NBA Champion and Olympic Gold medal coach and former Chicago Bull Steve Ker returned to the United Center. As a kid who grew up watching him play, it was powerful to see him assert his platform and voice to protect our democracy. Kerr poked fun at Walz's coaching tactics, and was blunt about Trump's leadership failures. Steve Kerr is someone I admire not just for his athletic accomplishments, but more importantly, for his character. While many of his fame and fortune avoid 'controversial conversations,' Steve Kerr is someone who has consistently stood up against bigotry, Islamophobia, and has loudly condemned "the demolition of Gaza."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7ba04f74-26f2-4d8d-8cfe-0e51f570110d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
One of the most powerful moments of the evening was from a Kentucky woman named Hadley Duvall, who joined two other women on stage to advocate for abortion access. [Duvall is a sexual abuse survivor, who was impregnated via rape by her stepfather when she was 12 years old](https://substack.com/redirect/dc7467fc-1eb1-4598-a35b-bc9b6da0d9c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). In her 2:30 minute speech she spoke about the importance of protecting women and children and condemned Donald Trump's abortion bans. But her line of the night that left every one in a gasp went as follows:
> [Donald Trump] calls it 'a beautiful thing.' What is so beautiful about a child having to carry her parents' child? There are other survivors out there who have no options. And I want you to know we see you, we hear you. Kamala Harris will sign a national law to restore the right to an abortion.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0cf836ad-20c0-4423-93cb-0484906eaaad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Amanda Zurawski, Kaitlyn Joshua, and Hadley Duvall spoke on reproductive rights at the DNC. Credit: **Getty Images / Newsweek**
Former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton spoke about finally breaking the glass ceiling by electing a woman to the White House. Clinton likewise appeared visibly pleased when the crowd chanted "Lock Him Up," in reference to Donald Trump running for President with 34 felony convictions. In complete transparency, I am not a fan of the Democratic Party beating down Trump for being a felon, given the disparate treatment of low income people and people of color in the criminal justice system. I believe this is an opportunity to instead elevate the discourse on rectifying our unjust criminal justice system, as that will additionally activate more people to vote and play a role in building that more perfect Union.
President Biden closed out the night, in perhaps his last major address to the country as President. In his remarks he acknowledged the pro-peace protestors outside as "[having a point](https://substack.com/redirect/8e4063d4-a00d-41a1-90e8-01e3d54eaac4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." I appreciated this, but returning to the start of this overview, this is where things also went down hill. As President Biden spoke, peaceful protestors within the United Center unfurled a large sign calling to stop arming Israel--and were met with assault.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/983f48b4-67dc-40cd-b55c-95419ce95d69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A[ yet unidentified white man took his sign and physically assaulted a hijab wearing Muslim woman holding the sign](https://substack.com/redirect/e84cdd67-33c7-4a20-9b97-966b05a53e61?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). To my knowledge he was not reprimanded or removed for his assault. President Biden insisted that he's deputized his Secretary of State to get a deal done, and that they've made immense progress. Unfortunately, the deal proposed by Biden and Blinken is a complete contradiction of the deal already proposed and approved back in early June. If you recall, [Israel condemned the US backed UN Security Council resolution in support of Israel's own ceasefire deal](https://substack.com/redirect/5aa5588b-d290-4537-bea0-6e56a5cc2462?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/983511e8-9ca2-4f94-8dae-46bba3cfd651?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Unsurprisingly, Hamas immediately rejected this new deal because it completely contradicts what Hamas and Israel agreed to months ago. Instead, this new deal does not mandate permanent ceasefire and release of all hostages, it keeps Israel occupying Gaza, and it keeps Israel in control of the Rafah border--meaning that Netanyahu can continue to block aid at will, as he has for the last 10 months. Just as revealing, Netanyahu senior aides admit to Axios that he only accepted the deal from Blinken because he knew Hamas would reject it.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9c8e940f-367d-4419-a27b-5524de4fdae9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The calls to stop arming Netanyahu are growing, and significantly, these calls are not just from the progressive base of the Democratic Party. Former Speaker [Nancy Pelosi has loudly called to stop arming Netanyahu](https://substack.com/redirect/c8a2a283-e024-4581-a108-1134285f90bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and polling shows that doing so will better enable a victory for Kamala Harris in November. For example, [as first reported by Zeteo](https://substack.com/redirect/a2dad572-0aa4-4178-b1ea-48c56b97d083?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Among Georgia Democrats and Independents:
* 44% are more likely to vote for Harris if Biden secures a ceasefire, while just 2% are less likely.
* 39% are more likely to vote for Harris if she pledges to stop weapons to Israel, and just 5% are less likely.

This is a major contrast, and polling shows similar support to stop arming Netanyahu in swing states like Pennsylvania and Arizona. The bottom line is this: Americans are tired of war, tired of war crimes, and tired of our tax dollars funding these war crimes. The DNC has an opportunity to further distance Democrats from the pro-war policies of Republicans, but it cannot be mere words. We need action. Notably, Georgia Senator Raphael Warnock particularly called on the need to protect _all_ children, and mentioned Palestinian children by name. I'm hopeful we can move beyond words, and into actions to make that happen.
The DNC Day 1 was an eventful and effective day, but clearly we have work to do and cannot relent in our advocacy for justice for all. I'll be at the DNC for Day 2 today.
