| Demand Transparency: Call on Secretary Galvin to Release Critical Information on $1 Billion Migrant Crisis Spending
---
---
|
The Healey-Driscoll Administration has kept Massachusetts residents in the dark regarding the allocation of nearly $1 billion spent on the migrant crisis, as well as the details of over 600 "serious incidents" reported in taxpayer-funded housing. Despite our repeated calls for transparency, the Governor and Lieutenant Governor have refused to release this crucial information.
We urge you to join us in calling on Acting Governor, Secretary Bill Galvin, to take action. Secretary Galvin is the longest-serving executive in Massachusetts and at times has had an independent voice. Now, he has the opportunity to uphold his commitment to the people of the Commonwealth by releasing the unredacted information on vendor payments and the serious incidents within state shelters.
Contact Secretary Galvin's office today and ask him to ensure transparency and accountability in the use of public funds. Massachusetts residents deserve nothing less.
Secretary William Galvin's Office Contact: Phone: 617-727-7030 Email: [CIS@sec.state.ma.us](mailto:CIS@sec.state.ma.us)
Here's what we know:
* Details surrounding taxpayer-funded spending on the migrant crisis have been deliberately concealed from the public.
* Nearly 8,000 migrant families have been housed in facilities that are projected to cost taxpayers over $1 billion in FY 2024.
* The appropriation of this $1 billion sum remains undisclosed to the public.
* The Healey-Driscoll Administration has withheld critical information, including the identities of vendors involved and the amounts they are being paid.
* Investigative journalists uncovered that a hotel in Methuen charged the state $165 per night, despite 330 documented health violations by local inspectors.
* Providers managing taxpayer-funded shelters have reported approximately 600 "serious incidents," many requiring police, fire, or medical intervention.
* Details of these serious incidents remain redacted, with the only publicly known case being an alleged rape of a minor, revealed by the Rockland police department.
* The Healey-Driscoll Administration has refused to provide further information to the public.

subject: A few words about the Medal of Honor.....

body:
Donald Trump has shown that he does not have the faintest idea of what valor means, or bravery, or self sacrifice. He does not understand these things, and he does not value them.
#
Peter,
You have no doubt heard Trump’s shameful comments about the brave few who earned our nation’s highest, most sacred Military honor — the Medal of Honor. In comparing the Medal of Honor to the Presidential Medal of Freedom, Trump’s degradation of the award we revere so highly is not his only error.
Despite Trump’s comments, there is no equivalent award to the Medal of Honor. None. It has been given to fallen Americans who shielded their comrades from grenades with their own bodies. Who dragged the wounded from harm's way, repeatedly, at the risk of their own lives. Who put themselves between the enemy and their friends against all odds, with complete disregard for their own survival. For outstanding courage, for self sacrifice, for extraordinary valor in combat.
In Trump’s case, you are awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom for being a political ally or a donor. And, apparently, he thinks that’s “better” than someone who receives the Medal of Honor. This is a window into who Trump truly is.
As I said, Trump’s degradation of this honor is not his only error. In doing so, he reinforces what we have known for years: Donald Trump does not have the faintest idea of what valor means, or bravery, or self sacrifice. He does not understand these things, and he does not value them.
A man who asked “What was in it for them?” at the grave of a fallen Marine cannot be trusted to order the finest, most powerful Military in the history of the world into combat. He cannot be expected to discharge the solemn responsibility that these fighting men and women are owed. But today, as you read this, Donald Trump stands on the precipice of becoming president once more.
It is up to us to prevent that from happening. Our Military deserves a leader with honor, with respect, with understanding. I’m proud to join VoteVets in their work to defeat Trump, once and for all.
And today, I am asking you to support that work.

Peter -

We only have 89 days until Election Day! That means we only have 89 days to raise money, knock doors, make phone calls, and convince the voters of Nevada’s 3rd congressional district to support our vision to close our borders, protect our communities, empower parents, and make life affordable again.

Last week, I spent time with House Speaker Mike Johnson. The Speaker made it clear that he and other Republican leaders in Washington consider our race one of the best opportunities in America to pick up a seat in the House of Representatives. It’s a seat we must win if we want to keep – and expand – GOP control of the House.

That’s why House Republican Leadership, including Speaker Johnson, Majority Leader Steve Scalise, Majority Whip Tom Emmer, Republican Conference Chairman Elise Stefanik, National Republican Congressional Committee Chairman Richard Hudson, and my longtime friend, Republican Policy Committee Chairman Gary Palmer, have endorsed me and are fully supporting me as we fight to win this CRUCIAL race.

Mark your calendar! We have several great events coming up, including our Back to School Party in the Park this Saturday and a cookie swap featuring my inspiring wife Sarah on Sunday! Check out the “Upcoming Events” section below for all the details.

Finally, every dollar is vital as we fight to send corrupt Susie Lee packing!

Donate here. (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=47b2426ff0&e=fc26432468)

PS - If you know someone who would be interested in learning more about our campaign to turn this crucial toss-up House seat Republican, please forward them this email (https://us14.forward-to-friend.com/forward?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=d5b90d45bc&e=fc26432468) .

** Endorsement Alert!
------------------------------------------------------------

Drew is proud to have earned the support of Speaker Mike Johnson!
“I'm proud to endorse Drew Johnson in Nevada's 3rd Congressional District. With Drew's background of more than two decades creating solutions to cut wasteful spending, lower prescription drug costs, and promote energy independence at one of America's leading free market think tanks, he's exactly the kind of policy leader we need in Washington.

Electing Drew Johnson is critical to keeping and expanding our House majority, and I hope you'll join me in supporting him.”

** Upcoming Events
------------------------------------------------------------

** August 10 | 11 AM - 1 PM
------------------------------------------------------------
Bring your kids to the Back to School Party in the Park at Bruce Trent Park! There will be refreshments, food trucks, bounce houses, and plenty of free fun! Drew is co-hosting the event with two other amazing candidates and wonderful people, Jill Douglass, candidate for State Senate District 6, and Brandon Davis, candidate for State Assembly District 34.

**
August 11 | 2 PM - 3:30 PM
------------------------------------------------------------
Join Siena Patriots for a cookie swap and meet-and-greet with Sarah Johnson. Not only is Sarah Drew’s charming better half, she is also our state’s leading voice for entrepreneurs as the Director of the Nevada Office of Small Business Advocacy under our amazing Lieutenant Governor Stavros Anthony. Make sure to RSVP to Kerry Ferguson at the email or phone number below.

**
August 16 | 6 - 7:30 PM
------------------------------------------------------------
Our dedicated supporters Mason and Eimy Martinez are hosting a fun and informal evening with Sarah Johnson.

The event is aimed at women who want to learn more about the political landscape, find out about volunteer opportunities, and hear what it’s really like behind-the-scenes of a campaign.

Email Carolina to RSVP by August 9th. (mailto:carolina@drewfornevada.com?subject=RSVP%20for%20Aug%2016%20event)

**
August 17 | 10 AM
------------------------------------------------------------
Join Drew and other outstanding candidates at Turning Point Actions' Super Chase Nevada rally!

Drew and other leaders will discuss how to get out the vote and collect ballots so great Republican candidates can win up and down the ballot this November.

RSVP here. (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=8ce51012cc&e=fc26432468)
https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=8a326cda79&e=fc26432468

** In the Media
------------------------------------------------------------
Sam Shad interviewed Drew on Nevada Newsmakers (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=799181e4d2&e=fc26432468) to discuss his plans for improving the lives of voters in Nevada’s 3rd congressional district.

https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=22e172b10d&e=fc26432468

Read Drew’s latest column (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=96f1adb845&e=fc26432468) exposing how Democrats' attacks on America's system of intellectual property rights have discouraged innovation and threatened national security.
https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=dcfe224e9e&e=fc26432468
Don’t miss Drew’s Newsmax column explaining how some hospitals are exploiting a failed federal prescription drug program (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=cbd993fdbc&e=fc26432468) to rip off taxpayers and harm low-income patients.
https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=2097b01757&e=fc26432468
Drew joined AM670’s Live and Local with guest host Pat Casale (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=c014d9c09b&e=fc26432468) to talk about the issues Southern Nevadans are most concerned about and how to make sure great candidates win this November.

** YOU Can Help Us Defeat Susie Lee!
------------------------------------------------------------

Want to help Drew and make sure Republicans maintain control of the House of Representatives? We need your help! This race is going to be tight, and having supporters like you step up and lend a hand is vital!

Here are the TOP 3 ways YOU can get involved:

1. Donate: Simply chipping in a few dollars to support our efforts is incredibly helpful. Whether it's $3 or $3,000, every donation makes a huge difference! Just $18 buys coffee and donuts for volunteers! You can contribute to the campaign HERE (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=9e3c85fda7&e=fc26432468) .

2. Host a Meet-and-Greet for Drew: Hosting a Meet-and-Greet in your home for Drew and inviting your friends, family, and neighbors is one of the best ways to spread our message. Whether it’s a casual coffee meeting, a wine and cheese event, or a fun game night, we can make hosting easy. Interested in hosting a meet-and-greet? Email linnea@drewfornevada.com (mailto:linnea@drewfornevada.com?subject=I'd%20like%20to%20host%20a%20Meet%20%26%20Greet%20for%20Drew!) .

3. Volunteer for the Campaign: #TeamDrew is the secret weapon that will get Drew elected to Congress. We're knocking on tens of thousands of doors, writing thousands of postcards, and making as many phone calls as possible to make this campaign a success. And we can't do it without you! Please visit THIS (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=6d4218e85e&e=fc26432468) link to join #TeamDrew as a volunteer.

4. Put up a Yard Sign: One of the easiest and most effective ways to support our campaign is by putting a "Drew Johnson for Congress" sign in your yard. Almost every HOA in Southern Nevada allows at least one campaign yard sign. Email your name and address to Carolina@DrewforNevada.com and we'll ship one at NO COST to you!

subject: Receive Your “Ends of the Earth” DVD Today!
body:
The state of our world can be discouraging.

| | _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=654f0cb610b74f4d9ecdf322bcc1d90c&_t=nb0dwaKSM2jPbCWPVtywjwdsVCGuIeIvvdhgKhChLrd_QCAkWy_mztsw7Xgd1yjy6exIOVy48k20VIvWeVcMgJq6KcEnNa0kZMO-W_lHe9SlZKg5My0eritBRuW3WB_n)_
---
| | | [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=654f0cb610b74f4d9ecdf322bcc1d90c&_e=E1r0WqI4OCYGjpgT6OQVMN7ekOFKNTc38oqtvec_VawcvPVHLyaQq9E_nd0L8am5sb7qWSYGOjEs9GhedOxQxPyNZ4x5c17XvCyRThCmmZsAEVXyngl7riRooI1u-i2f5i87s2a8-l9z5mDGzMa8h7AxsHvWxDTOPhDiVbzQ-0ZhbNAGheerRF5PC-2Kdtk9Qi--Y2XbRfsEkOgJAvjTBfytxIdZrJSUjaQQdSkgQGF7-PuzlJ4t5oR_WELeGdx5RH01yMQ6hxkpj2gdkM8oEoKTmNzOqrVq5Lux6VUnIjbCF7c5pEIsseijaUoSA_FucRbZwB63ppRdNUBz8gJQmgUq7b6VO_wfSFKzvO7jIME%3D)
Dear Friend,

The state of our world can be discouraging. Spiritual lostness, global conflict, and political uncertainty can leave us feeling exhausted as we struggle to remind ourselves that God _is_ moving.

If you can relate, would you like an eye-opening chance to witness God at work in our world? If so, we have an inspiring opportunity for you that promises to open your mind to God's ultimate reach.

MAF's award-winning documentary, _Ends of the Earth_ , is an enlightening journey set against breathtaking landscapes and featuring the stories of people who are willing to risk it all for Christ. This documentary is a testament to faith, calling, and the adventures experienced by those who bring help, hope, and healing to the ends of the earth.

[And we'd like to provide you with a copy of the _Ends of the Earth_ DVD as a thank-you for a donation of $75!](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=654f0cb610b74f4d9ecdf322bcc1d90c&_e=E1r0WqI4OCYGjpgT6OQVMN7ekOFKNTc38oqtvec_VawcvPVHLyaQq9E_nd0L8am5sb7qWSYGOjEs9GhedOxQxPyNZ4x5c17XvCyRThCmmZsAEVXyngl7riRooI1u-i2f5i87s2a8-l9z5mDGzMa8h7AxsHvWxDTOPhDiVbzQ-0ZhbNAGheerRF5PC-2Kdtk9Qi--Y2XbRfsEkOgJAvjTBTJgoylbYE_R6dImBB7skcPykJB5Z4Gb4rrMnmKH19HFaQn2o0upzUdQElptia2Mr7h01G866Zd2Xi4dYlwKhNFlBLCbT5SFD55iCiekoLRu4Wg68hzTcMstL9v4ZNJndddKFYJh7PtqoMM9uBWvdMc%3D)

People in isolated regions are often cut off from the basic necessities of life. Imagine living in a place so remote that essential resources are scarce and hearing the gospel is a distant dream.

Through MAF's airplanes and missionaries, we have been able to reach these isolated places, delivering critical care and the good news of Jesus Christ. In _Ends of the Earth_ , you'll get to witness the life-changing moments where critical supplies and the hope of the gospel are brought to those in need.

[By making a donation of $75 today, you can help us continue this essential work and receive your copy of the _Ends of the Earth_ DVD as our way of saying thank you!](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=654f0cb610b74f4d9ecdf322bcc1d90c&_e=E1r0WqI4OCYGjpgT6OQVMN7ekOFKNTc38oqtvec_VawcvPVHLyaQq9E_nd0L8am5sb7qWSYGOjEs9GhedOxQxPyNZ4x5c17XvCyRThCmmZsAEVXyngl7riRooI1u-i2f5i87s2a8-l9z5mDGzMa8h7AxsHvWxDTOPhDiVbzQ-0ZhbNAGheerRF5PC-2Kdtk9Qi--Y2XbRfsEkOgJAvjTBQ0-I26OUrvrUo9mTXpUufhrDFMHuyDULfFNyso1FRknpXs-nN6vTLPLXzF7AyYq_GXs5VsXboy2N2E9L18Amy-GYOjD-yeymI8qith3gEC8CkvFhdF-swiVjJB7WS9_XhrWj7OP8_suyDxCZYmExxo%3D)

We hope it will open your heart to the immense love and dedication of these missionaries, and act as a reminder that God is _always_ at work!

Thank you for your compassion and willingness to be a part of this mission.

Tracey Werre
Director of Marketing
Mission Aviation Fellowship

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91171953/492969677/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDY3ZDA0NDMtMGQ1Zi1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=2HogEjEEXKyj-OuOyD-l3z_funlFXh6cHgXcb6yaRS8=&emci=5152a663-065f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=067d0443-0d5f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
We are fewer than 90 days from election day, and the mainstream media still has no idea how to cover Donald Trump’s campaign for president.
**Earlier this month, Trump held a 64 minute news conference that aired live and unedited on every major cable news network in the U.S. He used the free air time to tell more than 162 lies – that’s more than two every minute.**
MSNBC host Lawrence O’Donnell used his opening monologue that same night to criticize and warn the media (including his own bosses at MSNBC):
_“It’s 2016 all over again. The same mistakes are being made. I have never seen an industry slower at learning from its own stupid mistakes than the American news business.”_
**[We’ll get into why the media is struggling to cover Trump’s campaign fairly in a second, but if you support COURIER’s mission to hold the mainstream media accountable for their biased Trump coverage, can you chip in $20 now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91171956/492969680/-593472309?refcode=20240820-EM-MSNBCTrumpConferenceResend&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDY3ZDA0NDMtMGQ1Zi1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=2HogEjEEXKyj-OuOyD-l3z_funlFXh6cHgXcb6yaRS8=)**
Trump and his team are floundering, Peter. Harris has received widespread support, including a massive increase in both fundraising and poll numbers.
So Trump turned to his standard campaign strategy: sharing countless lies in an attempt to get media attention. **The worst part? It worked.**
Every major cable news channel, including MSNBC, aired his hour-long press conference in full, with no live fact-checking or editing. He had a free platform to spread endless lies to anyone who tuned in.
As Lawrence O’Donnell pointed out, these networks had the capacity and ability to provide live fact-checking. But they didn’t.
These networks also had the capacity and ability to air Kamala Harris’ speech the same day. But they didn’t. They made no attempt to even appear balanced.
The truth is, Donald Trump drives an insane amount of views and clicks for these media companies, and those drive profits. Balance, fact-checking, and truth-telling aren’t the priority for the mainstream media – money is. The future of democracy be damned.
**These are the exact same mistakes the media made in 2016. We can’t let them keep getting away with it.**
Here’s the good news: COURIER was founded for this moment. We saw what happened in 2016, and we want to make sure it never happens again.
Our reporters work around the clock to hold the mainstream media accountable for platforming Trump and his lies. And we publish our own factual reporting on the issues that matter most, including fact-checking the former president.
[**We have less than three months until election day. If you can, can you chip in $20 to support our crucial work?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91171958/492969682/-593472309?refcode=20240820-EM-MSNBCTrumpConferenceResend&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDY3ZDA0NDMtMGQ1Zi1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=2HogEjEEXKyj-OuOyD-l3z_funlFXh6cHgXcb6yaRS8=)

Derek, it's Elissa Slotkin.
Trump will be in Howell, Michigan today for his second visit since formally accepting the Republican nomination and naming J.D. Vance as his running mate – and his 7th time since kicking off his 2024 campaign.
Howell also happens to be in my current Congressional district, and I’ll explain why that’s important in a moment.
But first, I am asking for a contribution — $20 or whatever you can afford — before Donald Trump gets here today. If that's all you need to hear, please use this link to split a donation to Tim Kaine and my campaign today:
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin] [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin] secure.actblue/slotkin-2024x19 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin]
Howell, Michigan is a historically conservative town I won by *13 votes* in 2022.
It's in Livingston County, a county that Trump won with 60% of the vote against Joe Biden last time around.
If you’ve followed any of our three campaigns, you've heard me say that a key objective for us is to "lose better." That means doing just a little bit better in the Republican-leaning areas of Michigan.
Howell, the place Trump is visiting, was at the heart of that strategy in my last election.
So it is no surprise that Trump and likely Mike Rogers will be there.
Because they know what I know: if I can "lose better" in places like Livingston, County -- we are going to win this Senate race, and we are likely to help Kamala Harris win as well.
That’s what we have to do, but I cannot do it alone.
It would be a huge boon to our campaign if you would chip in and show your support before Trump gets here. Our goal is to send a message that we are NOT letting them win back Michigan! Even a single $10 or $20 contribution to Tim Kaine and my campaign goes a long way when lots of folks are chipping in. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin]

Idaho is under attack by out-of-state, progressive elites who want to destroy our way of life.
These far-left activists have watched in frustration as their radical policies fail time and time again in Idaho. They can't stand that our state has remained a bastion of conservative values, so now they're resorting to dirty tricks to dismantle our elections.
Prop 1 is a Trojan horse, disguised as a simple change to our primary system, but it's nothing more than a ploy to rig our elections in favor of the radical left. The backers of Prop 1 have lied to Idahoans, claiming it will create a new "open" primary. The truth? It will blow up our current system, replacing it with a convoluted Top 4 primary that paves the way for left-wing radicals to gain a foothold in Idaho.
_**But the deception doesn't stop there ... **_
The most sinister part of Prop 1 is what it will do to our general elections. Right now, Idaho's counties, like Bonner and Boundary, use secure paper ballots, hand-counted to ensure election integrity. Prop 1 will destroy that, forcing us to adopt shady voting systems, like the infamous Dominion machines, and introduce Ranked Choice Voting--a confusing, fraud-prone process that will undermine the sanctity of your vote.
_**Imagine going to the polls and being forced to rank radical candidates like Kamala Harris alongside true patriots like Donald Trump.**_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b4982f8d-7a41-4927-9e81-12b076f30bb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Under Prop 1, if you don't play their game, your ballot might be thrown out. This is not just an attack on our election process; it's an assault on the very concept of one person, one vote.
Prop 1 will make our elections more chaotic, less secure, and way more expensive. It's a leftist scheme to turn Idaho into the next California--a state overrun by progressive policies that have driven people to flee in droves. We cannot let that happen here. Idaho is a beacon of freedom in a country that's increasingly falling under the grip of leftist tyranny.
We must protect it.
_**Vote NO on Prop 1 this November 5, and tell your friends, family, and neighbors to do the same.**_
We will not let the radical left destroy Idaho.

---
[](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=3caf15f139da42e2800d59759b947c71&_e=H9OmQXVi5t6sTQZI02xJ26aAE79EIqN_0d4qruNQH0hTQyo1jyEG-pyUAVne6v_AqEA4obTDAqOwEsO0X0uTMggyUB7kGBX_J8J1GdA50-Ae14A6v1Li3QUjWEhw10YtnmTaysje0znpdQY0qXVi5Y76TAlTvm-BtYDWUgaQU0KRByiIhXogCqcivyRxbzbpbJoWt0yIIHbCKVkliV4a4A%3D%3D)
---
_**7 reasons to fear Kamala Harris' radical 'Medicare-for-all' schemes**_ By Bobby Jindal and Hannah I. Anderson _Kamala Harris' radical ideas would put the government in charge of health care instead of doctors_
---

I took on the Clinton Machine.

**Aloha - this is FORMER Democrat Tulsi Gabbard. My former party came after me for the high crime of standing up to Hillary Clinton at the height of her power in 2016. **

A lot has changed since then - for starters, I'm no longer a Democrat.

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=7286%2E5257348%2EGitQAZ ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek,

At his absolutely ridiculous, rambling Mar-a-Lago press conference earlier
this month, Donald Trump made a whole host of outrageous comments and
claims.

This one didn’t make a huge splash amidst the other insane things he said,
but it stood out to me:

"If anybody I know is Jewish and they would vote for Kamala over me, they
should have their heads examined."

Well, I am Jewish. And I am proudly going to cast my vote for Vice
President Kamala Harris. But I certainly don’t want my head examined by
Donald Trump.

I’m proud of my Jewish faith,
Derek. From a
young age, Judaism has guided my values. Especially the teaching of Tikkun
Olam, or repairing the world.

Over the last few years, there has been a lot that was broken, and a lot
to fix.

But Tikkun Olam guides me in the fight we face today: repairing and
rebuilding our democracy so that we leave it better for my children and
yours.

That’s why I put everything I have into my work in Congress and for the
cause of our democracy. It’s the first thing I think about when I wake up
in the morning, and I don’t rest until I’ve done all I can for the day.

**Tulsi practically ended Kamala Harris ' presidential campaign last time. Her message for the American People is more important than ever.**

You should read it if you haven't already.

I took on the Clinton Machine.

And I paid the price for it.

**Aloha - this is FORMER Democrat Tulsi Gabbard. My former party came after me for the high crime of standing up to Hillary Clinton at the height of her power in 2016. **

A lot has changed since then - for starters, I'm no longer a Democrat.

Like so many, the Democrat Party left me behind and became the Party of corporate elitists, warmongers, and anti-freedom propagandists. _(In fact, I literally wrote the book about doing what 's RIGHT for our country and LEAVING the Democrat Party!)_

The rot is too deep - it can't be fixed, it must be driven out entirely.

That's why I'm sending you this email. I have a plan to bring down the ENTIRE cabal of Elites running the Democrat Party. We need to raise 100K dollars by tonight so we can begin to put our plan into action.

We're short of that goal by about 7%.

_**[So- with a humble heart, a spine of steel, and love of our great country - I respectfully ask you for a small contribution of 10 or 25 dollars. Will you stand with me?](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyU0bGK3DAQBuCnkTsZaWTL2sLFwWFIceEgRUqhSLPeAVkykuy9xw8ObJUmqYdv_vmZnx_2w1GktH53G85Uqy3VttNW7yK_5xjzk9LKj92CgIELw0FY2YV5BGnupsNZTjDIyYib6B6zMKMewYO8CT8F48cJjRHB_dJmkOhcR_O1RxgQchJKmj7gbfLjTQnp7xoGyQZx7ME17ClVClh9zvueIzXytc9l7eL8aG2vTL0xWBgsFf1RsH9SKhh6nzcGS0O38asDVWSw-Eip5cQ35x-UkLcjVrq0WsqlC6WVqfdWDmSgj7ZZ77bd0ZqYen8dbD_f-Lcfn7KXUmk12CZHpaQZuZxGzUDjl20U_gP8ycmpYWpX-MmpVv7CDPTXkc6_B12Zw_6kGKnqiQ1i3RzFq3bX_v1_5wy_AwAA___uV5uT "So – with a humble heart and spine of steel – I respectfully ask you for a small contribution of 10 or 25 bucks. | Peter, I joined Governor Youngkin and Secretary Guidera today to receive a briefing on the status of Virginia's students and the lingering effects of **' Wreck-it' Ralph Northam's detrimental decision to CLOSE Virginia schools.** **Last year, the data was clear:** _Virginia students suffered the most extreme learning loss, more than any other state._ As a father, and as someone who coached high-school sports for YEARS, I couldn't begin to fathom **how far behind** this next generation of young Virginians was. In response to the **egregious** learning loss we saw in students, and the rise in chronic absenteeism, Governor Youngkin worked with the General Assembly to make a **historic investment of $418 million in our schools** and established the [_ALL IN VA_](https://f1v3ff69.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.doe.virginia.gov%2Fteaching-learning-assessment%2Fall-in-va/1/0100019170c94123-55cbd5da-e48c-4732-a881-0b1748e1e01c-000000/jiFOzdNy35r_0BDH0HcAU45QkA8=388) initiative. The ALL IN VA initiative has focused on developing unique 3-year-plans with each Virginia school division to address **attendance issues, literacy rates, and learning loss**. The program carries a heavy focus on intensive tutoring. ALL IN VA was so popular that, just three months after its inception, **_every single school division in Virginia had submitted an approved ALL IN VA plan_**.
---
| | |
---
| I'm proud to report that Governor Youngkin's team has achieved some **_outstanding results!_** Virginia students, grades 3-8, saw improvements in reading test scores and an even greater jump in math test scores. The groups of students who were **hit hardest** by learning loss have also **bounced back the strongest.** Chronic absenteeism is down 16%: that's **over 40,000 students back in the classroom** attending school regularly. ALL IN VA has been a huge success, and I look forward to continuing to work alongside Governor Youngkin ensuring that _Virginia is the best place to live, to work, and to raise a family._ Yours in service,
---
| | |
---

| _Press Release_
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:

POLLING DATA

FROM: GLEN BOLGER & JIM HOBART
RE: KEY FINDINGS - MARYLAND CD 6 GENERAL ELECTION SURVEY

DATE: AUGUST 20, 2024

_Methodology_
On behalf of Parrott for Congress and the NRCC, Public Opinion Strategies conducted 400
interviews among likely voters in Maryland Congressional District 6, with 83% of interviews
completed via cell phone and 17% completed via landline. The survey was completed August 6-
11, 2024, and has a margin of error of +4.9% in 95 out of 100 cases.

_Key Findings_

**1\. The political environment in Maryland CD 6 currently favors Republicans.**
Nearly two-thirds (65%) of voters say the country is off on the wrong track, including
majorities of Independents (68%) and soft Democrats (59%).

President Biden’s approval rating is underwater. Fully 54% of voters disapprove of
Biden, with 46% saying they strongly disapprove of him.

The generic Congressional ballot also shows that this district is more in play than it has
been in previous cycles, with 43% of voters backing a generic Republican candidate, and
44% backing the generic Democrat.

**2\. The congressional race is a tossup.**
With just under three months until the election, Maryland CD 6 is as tight as it can be.
Neil Parrott checks in with 40% of the vote and April Delaney at 42%. Potential third
party candidates received 4% of the vote, and 13% of voters are undecided.

Encouragingly, the undecided voters disapprove of Biden (62%) and prefer a Republican
candidate who will be a check and balance to Democrats in Washington (45%) over a
Democratic candidate who will help Democrats pass their agenda (37%).

This suggests these voters will be open to voting for Parrott as they learn more about
him during the course of the campaign.

**3\. Parrott also has the advantage among voters most interested in voting in the November election.**
Among voters who rate their interest a 10 (very high) in voting come November, Neil
Parrott leads 45% to 42%. This is yet another reason for Republicans to be optimistic
about this race.

**The Bottom Line**
Neil Parrott is running a strong campaign and has a real chance to flip this seat from blue to red.

| TFVC’s annual “Wall of Shame” campaign highlights several of the more egregious **misrepresentations of exemption laws** made by school districts and individual campuses in the lead-up to the start of the school year.
_**(Not So) Fun Fact: The current statute requiring schools to provide exemption information allows for these misrepresentations since it applies to ISD websites ONLY.**_ __As a result, many districts continue to mislead parents and guardians by**conveniently omitting** vaccine exemption options or claiming that necessities, like supply lists or class schedules, can be provided when shot records, and only shot records, are on file.
As important as it is to call out schools who misrepresent exemption laws, it is just as essential to applaud those districts who **clearly inform parents** of their rights. That’s why we are happy to bring you our first “**Wall of Praise** ,” featuring Fort Bend ISD.
Thank you, FBISD, for **accurately informing your district parents** of all of the options available to meet vaccine paperwork requirements & providing an exemption FAQ page. Well done! Gold stars all around!

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8a74024814fa48c5a62cfb568c3c78dc&_e=OvL7nhqCF-1ZPtCvG5fuisB6gS8BgZv4KG0-vcPJpuS0lcSPTx1HDq5bdm5yFzBl2cSNsvc4YvwnGsq9fD6xFU9kZVSEyhtsTHiNrwxw8z6gdevFQIZR7n6C6pgi5H_Z5E4L7GQS-x_KVlNgh8SOqVaA9Qaq8ukthq32B-5DrsfITswT81XR0llFPFgaqYhFLq5O9-bYBL-aDoclla-4XMktWj2Z02YxGT63I9NN3E9_Aywvzeq7voKxqKrauwgaYWIJBkzRXqaLSp1fvfg7ujFzbKCaP5tZzCp7iOzwTsvsEwndvAPjXus13-TYIknrLdx6YBfkSARJsBZepqYggiSfyhBJ5M6McWORu28lKzE2ayJOYLVWq-XJUkBuBGLZ)
Fellow Patriot,

I wanted to take a moment to share something that worries me about our society.

Too many black students despise America.

Too many black students despise white people.

And many people believe that all black students should think the same way.

My name is **Jasmyn Jordan** , and I'm a student at the University of Iowa. As a young black woman, I was told that I needed to "conform" to the identity that the Left created for me.

White liberals and radical African Americans wanted me to promote Critical Race Theory and speak out about my "oppression."

But my parents didn't raise me to be a victim. My dad is a hard-working, patriotic American truck driver who listens to conservative talk radio. Often, my parents reminded me that in America we can all have our own opinions thanks to freedom of speech.

At the University of Iowa, I chose to become a committed conservative student through Young America's Foundation (YAF), the nation's leading youth outreach organization. I decided more students at the University of Iowa need to be warned about Critical Race Theory and instead hear your conservative ideas!

_The backlash from the campus Left was almost immediate._

The campus Left attacked me, calling me a "token," a bigot, a Nazi, and even a white supremacist.

Even today, they don't like seeing that there is a black female conservative who is actively participating and leading in Young America's Foundation.

But my parents raised me to have courage, so **[I proudly began to share your ideas with my fellow students through YAF](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8a74024814fa48c5a62cfb568c3c78dc&_e=OvL7nhqCF-1ZPtCvG5fuisB6gS8BgZv4KG0-vcPJpuS0lcSPTx1HDq5bdm5yFzBl2cSNsvc4YvwnGsq9fD6xFU9kZVSEyhtsTHiNrwxw8z6gdevFQIZR7n6C6pgi5H_Z5E4L7GQS-x_KVlNgh8SOqVaA9Qaq8ukthq32B-5DrsfITswT81XR0llFPFgaqYhFLq5O9-bYBL-aDoclla-4XC8vwAn4jkX3iKfIwj1fMj_1t6ACaxrglaqv23a5smnTjNV71wUrv5KWnmjw3G2IZtz6C4r83hxLUCZzd7Ohg8Nt5pGj-wC417RLyXhWSf751G3KW6-ZkByy_Cn_h2-xeO-ZuBMtkWGz0j6DdF72SIr5hgrWhqadNn0FGvwWssnH)**. My fellow conservative students and I took the lead to host YAF speakers on campus, including **Matt Walsh** , Lt. Col. **Allen West** , **Vince Everett Ellison** , award-winning swimmer **Paula Scanlan** , and others.

We were determined to share your conservative ideas with as many students as possible at the University of Iowa.

I even testified before the U.S. House Judiciary Committee about the personal attacks I faced for defending free speech on campus. And I have now been appointed as the new national chairwoman for Young Americans for Freedom to oversee the largest coast-to-coast network of young conservatives! [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8a74024814fa48c5a62cfb568c3c78dc&_e=OvL7nhqCF-1ZPtCvG5fuisB6gS8BgZv4KG0-vcPJpuS0lcSPTx1HDq5bdm5yFzBl2cSNsvc4YvwnGsq9fD6xFU9kZVSEyhtsTHiNrwxw8z6gdevFQIZR7n6C6pgi5H_Z5E4L7GQS-x_KVlNgh8SOqVaA9Qaq8ukthq32B-5DrsfITswT81XR0llFPFgaqYhFLq5O9-bYBL-aDoclla-4XE88ks_o7vF0Fx_ROqaBqacw-Pi47WWzflRPu9dd4Z-s9UVaoFelvPcxTPq8GWEHNXvABYJ0ijaAyIwpcCWfW5pFxLT-81wmZGeHaX-TVVIgLS0kt_xn70nUVzroBmi6IyjgFJ_yDaDziMCDA5is_th_RLsunOmFUHtG9_oiFWJt) More young people, especially young African Americans, need to hear that America is not "racist" and instead be inspired by your conservative values!

That's why each day I do everything I can to warn my fellow students of the dangers of Critical Race Theory and share your values with my peers at the University of Iowa.

And it's why I'm so passionate about Young America's Foundation-the most effective youth outreach organization recruiting the largest audiences of young people into the Conservative Movement.

Without YAF, none of my conservative activism would have been possible.

**But we can 't keep recruiting students at the University of Iowa or on college campuses nationwide without your help.** There are thousands of African-American students at the University of Iowa who need to hear the dangers and immorality of Critical Race Theory. You can help educate new, young audiences!

Specifically, we need 50 passionate conservatives to step forward before midnight with a gift of $50, so Young America's Foundation can inspire thousands more students on campuses nationwide with the truth about the values that make us great.

According to one poll, only 36% of young people ages 18 to 24 are proud of being American. But your gift right now will help change that. It changed it for me, and I know it will change it for students like me who only hear about how bad their country is instead of why they should be proud of it.

Here's where you can securely make your gift to Young America's Foundation to inspire and recruit young americans to save our country: [**https://secure.yaf.org/inspire-and-recruit-young-americans**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8a74024814fa48c5a62cfb568c3c78dc&_e=OvL7nhqCF-1ZPtCvG5fuisB6gS8BgZv4KG0-vcPJpuS0lcSPTx1HDq5bdm5yFzBl2cSNsvc4YvwnGsq9fD6xFU9kZVSEyhtsTHiNrwxw8z6gdevFQIZR7n6C6pgi5H_Z5E4L7GQS-x_KVlNgh8SOqVaA9Qaq8ukthq32B-5DrsfITswT81XR0llFPFgaqYhFLq5O9-bYBL-aDoclla-4XPgL-OIQQ_L398qtz1-zOVOdT8sEILbZIPqxYSRbCvl2Y7nXfBcexncGVzTK2X4rfEJWZ1c6HV4D9cm1PInqRhbIdV8kmnboYHrXyUZhNVtyVRZzD6tJE8PX28KffscGoCXFE2s5dKgWvkyW68r28I6U9egJsi-UFLaGpPQwSIbA)

I'm so grateful you are standing with us to pass on your ideas to future generations. Together we will reach more young people with the values that make America exceptional.

Gratefully,

Jasmyn Jordan
**Chairwoman, Young Americans for Freedom**
**Chairwoman, University of Iowa YAF**
* * *

Reston, VA 20191-1556

body:
As the election heats up we need your help ensuring that Kennedy's message reaches every corner of the country.

| | |

Peter --[](https://www.kennedy24.com/?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=callers_for_kennedy_3&n=1)
---
The best way to support Kennedy right now is by joining our **Callers for Kennedy** team—an incredible opportunity to make a real impact, connect with like-minded individuals, help recruit more volunteers and share Kennedy’s message of unity with voters.
---
**Special Incentives Program: Callers for Kennedy** To show our appreciation, we're excited to introduce our Callers for Kennedy Program. Callers who make **1000 calls in 7 consecutive days** will earn a FREE Kennedy shirt or hat! It's a small token of our gratitude for your invaluable support.
---
**How to Get Started:**
1. **Sign Up:** [Click here](https://www.kennedy24.com/r?u=hVoQD_UXEHovndQzLe8Ilbj1Mjk9HveJXjJ_gq_PsdNbAMgEDOZKIDCdp_4cHFstDe6TJfa3eUUHYzWUU2iJLnzCu6Kcrmr-rDvT4HWRPnCrGSiXk5Urb25IhsNKaxXJHaPEZya1lhN-Z5bX4eUa_A&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=callers_for_kennedy_3&n=2) to sign up and join our calling/texting team.
2. **Training:** We'll provide all the training and resources you need to start making calls. [Sign up for a training here!](https://www.kennedy24.com/phone-banking-events?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=callers_for_kennedy_3&n=3)
3. **Start Calling:** Connect with persuadable voters, share Kennedy's vision and encourage them to vote!

---
Our calling system makes it easy, anonymous and fun. Scripts are provided and you can make calls at your convenience between 9am-9pm local time, from the comfort of your couch!
---
Every call you make brings us one step closer to victory. Whether you’re a seasoned caller or new to the experience, your passion and dedication are what will make the difference. **Let's make history together- one call at a time!** Thank you for your unwavering support, Team Kennedy
---

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: A rare and precious opportunity
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Over the next 77 days, we will have to pour every ounce, every minute, every moment into making history on November 5th.
#
_Alexandria spoke at the Democratic National Convention last night,[you can watch her remarks here.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/28560?c0=aoc-email-20240820-1.S26S3l&refcode=em20240820-7041-P_FND_RES_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7041%2E2526796%2EPRMbOU)_
Six years ago, I was taking omelet orders as a waitress in New York City. I didn’t have health insurance. My family was fighting off foreclosure, and we were struggling with bills after my dad passed away unexpectedly from cancer.
Like millions of Americans, we were just looking for an honest shake. And we were tired of cynical politics that seemed blind to the realities of working people.
It was then, only through the miracles of democracy and community, that the good people of The Bronx and Queens chose someone like me to elect them in Congress. And America, in my heart, I know from that same cloth of hope and aspiration, we will also elect Kamala Harris and Tim Walz as President and Vice President of the United States of America.
**America has before us a rare and precious opportunity. In Kamala Harris, we have a chance to elect a President who is _for_ the middle class — because she is _from_ the middle class.** She understands the urgency of rent checks and groceries and prescriptions. She is as committed to our reproductive and civil rights as she is to taking on corporate greed. She is working tirelessly to secure a ceasefire in Gaza and bringing hostages home.
**In Kamala Harris, I see a leader who understands.** I see a leader with a real commitment to a better future for working families. We have to help her win. Because we know that Donald Trump would sell this country for a dollar if it meant lining his own pockets and greasing the palms of his Wall Street friends.
And I for one am tired of hearing about how a two bit union buster thinks of himself as more of a patriot than the woman who fights every single day to lift working people out from under the boots of greed trampling on our way of life.
**The truth is, Don, you cannot love this country if you only fight for the wealthy and big business.** To love this country is to fight for its people. All people. Working People. Everyday Americans like bartenders and factory workers and fast food cashiers who punch a clock and are on their feet all day in some of the toughest jobs out there.
You know, ever since I got elected, Republicans have attacked me by saying that I should go back to bartending. **But let me tell you, I’m happy to any day of the week, because there is nothing wrong with working for a living.**
Imagine having leaders in the White House who understand that. Leaders like Kamala and Tim. But, just because the choice is clear to us, does not mean the path will be easy.
**Over the next 77 days, we will have to pour every ounce, every minute, every moment into making history on November 5th.** But, we cannot send Kamala and Tim to the White House alone. Together, we must also elect strong Democratic majorities in the House and in the Senate, so that we can deliver on an ambitious agenda for the people.
Because if you are a working parent trying to afford rent and child care, Kamala is for you. If you are a senior who had to go back to work because your retirement didn’t stretch far enough, Kamala is for you. If you’re an immigrant family just starting your American story, Kamala is for you.
America, when we knock on our neighbor’s door, organize our communities, and elect Kamala Harris to the presidency on November 5th, we will send a loud message that the people of this nation will not go back. We choose a new path and open the door to a new day. One that is for the people and by the people.
[Help us continue the fight for social, economic, environmental, and racial justice by making a grassroots donation right now.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240820-1.o9M78G&refcode=em20240820-7041-P_FND_RES_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7041%2E2526796%2EPRMbOU)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240820-1.o9M78G&refcode=em20240820-7041-P_FND_RES_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=7041%2E2526796%2EPRMbOU)**
Thank you,
Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez

Will you pitch in $5 or anything you can to help us elect young progressive leaders?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240820?refcode=em20240820&amount=5&refcode2=1080_587540_oaVDmb&akid=1080%2E587540%2EoaVDmb)** **[MAKE A DNC DONATION »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240820?amount=5&refcode=em20240820-1080&refcode2=1080_587540_oaVDmb&akid=1080%2E587540%2EoaVDmb)**

Peter, it’s day two of the Democratic National Convention and I am SO SO PUMPED! 🇺🇸💙
This convention is a huge symbol of the momentum we are generating for the presidential ticket of Kamala Harris and Tim Walz across the nation. In the first 24 hours of the convention, I have met so many folks from all 50 delegations who are excited headed into November.
But, they’re not just excited for Kamala and Tim, Peter.
We’ve got historic candidates in pivotal races in so many places. In these races where excitement is at an all time high, the Harris-Walz ticket is going to ride the reverse coattails of these smaller races.
Typically, down ballot candidates have looked to the big fish running for President to bring voters out to the ballot. Folks used to think that if a Democrat is voting for the president, they will surely submit a wholly Democratic ballot! But we saw the reverse come true in 2016, and we’re likely to see it again this year too.
For example, Ashwin Ramaswami is running to be the first Gen Z Indian-American State Senator in Georgia – the youngest member to join the GA Senate. His campaign has energized the South Asian community in Georgia with folks submitting their ballots for the first time to support such a historic candidate. While these new voters are at the ballot, I’m sure they will also cast their vote for Kamala Harris – the soon-to-be first South Asian President.
It takes just one call, text, mailer, email, etc. to convince someone to cast their ballot – and with your support, Ashwin’s campaign can continue to reach every undecided voter until election day.
**[Will you make a $5 contribution towards our $10,000 DNC goal to strengthen our resolve in ushering in a huge blue wave through our support of historic and young down ballot candidates like Ashwin Ramaswami?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240820?refcode=em20240820&amount=5&refcode2=1080_587540_oaVDmb&akid=1080%2E587540%2EoaVDmb)**

There is a HUGE blue wave that is set to hit our shores in November and will affect every race up and down the ballot. We’ve got to do everything in our power to welcome it with open arms!
**David Hogg**

Hi Peter,

As the media’s attention turns to Chicago for the DNC events, we want to make sure you’re aware of a very important event happening 1,300 miles South in **Florida _today:_ Florida’s primary election.**

We are proud to be supporting some fiercely pro-choice candidates working to **UNSEAT the legislators who passed Florida’s abortion ban** , and many of them will be on the ballot TODAY! We want to make sure they have everything they’ll need to win from now until polls close this evening.

As a reminder, after the state banned almost all abortions, Florida voters will have the chance to pass a ballot measure this November that would restore reproductive healthcare access for millions of women. **_Today’s primary is the first step to ensuring that voters in Florida know what’s at stake and are ready to turn out for pro-choice candidates._**

Hi Peter,

Florida is going to be a key battleground state this November and their primary elections THIS TUESDAY are coming up fast! We are proud to endorse some fiercely pro-choice candidates working to unseat abortion-ban legislators.

[**Before we share more, please consider chipping in $20.24 or more today to help us rush last-minute support to our candidates in Florida ahead of Tuesday’s election →**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91188831/493014905/-1900451715?refcode=EM_F_240820FWD_N_AS_NO_4_NG_N_L2&amount=20.24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImUxM2Y3MWU5LTIyNWYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Brl_bF_LkAeOoS1vMPGUi4N9Xy5ormiSC6ngsDe1FC4=)

**Here is a look at our endorsed Florida candidates who have primaries on Tuesday:**

✅ **Rosemarie Latham (Florida House District 29) -** Rosemarie is running to unseat the man who introduced the Texas-style abortion ban in Florida. With abortion literally on the ballot, it’s critical that we support her campaign. She is committed to doing everything in her power to best represent and support ALL women and continue working to bring equity to the people.

✅ **Sarah Henry (Florida House District 38) -** Sarah is a much-needed pro-choice champion. As a high-schooler, she began volunteering as a clinic escort at her local Women’s Surgical Clinic. She found that the clinic and the region, as a whole, were constantly under attack by anti-choice protestors, and she became a target of these aggressors. Later in her career, she worked at a law firm representing that very Women’s Surgical Clinic in conjunction with the ACLU. As a member of the Florida House of Representatives, Sarah will embody that same pursuit of comprehensive, accessible, and safe reproductive healthcare for all people in need of it.

✅ **Stephanie Arguello (School Board in Seminole County, Florida) -** Stephanie is passionate about advocating for menstrual education and product access for healthy menstruation management. Over half the student and teacher population in her district is female, so she is committed to advocating to reduce the impact of period poverty. Her opponent is a Republican (who recently switched to “NPA” before this election cycle) whose children have been out of the school system for over a decade. The primary is the final race for this seat, so we must ensure she wins THIS TUESDAY.

✅ **Whitney Fox (U.S. Congress in Florida’s 13th congressional district) -** Whitney is running to unseat a self-described "pro-life extremist” and MAGA Republican. This district has been identified as a flippable red-to-blue seat by the DCCC. Whitney is running for Congress because she could not sit back as her two little girls grew up with fewer rights than she had when she was their age.

✅ **Kelly Smith (Florida State House of Representatives District 30) -** Kelly is running against a Republican incumbent who has a 100% voting history for Republican policy and has voted for every abortion ban in the state – including bans without exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. Kelly is determined to further legislation that would grant women more freedoms, fund better healthcare, childcare, and housing services, and work to reduce inequity experienced by women in underserved communities.

[**These women will be on the ballot THIS TUESDAY, and they urgently need our support as they fight to unseat extremist anti-choice legislators in Florida. Hi friend, it’s Chuck Schumer (emailing you from Chicago). The Democratic National Convention is officially underway, which means election season is heating up.

Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

clean_body: Plus: Redwood backpacking trips and tips | August 20, 2024 | Big tree bucket list It took an overseas flight and a journey to a forested island, but one family fulfilled their dream of strolling down South Korea’s “Metasequoia Lane” and spending time with the coast redwood’s fascinating cousins. Call to action Two studies surveyed groves where mega-fires had killed “parent trees”—and found an alarmingly low number of seedlings. Learn about the sequoia’s future risk and how the League and our partners are taking action. Style points Like personal stories inked upon skin, these tattoos capture unique connections to the trees—from memories of tribal homelands to an obsession with the salmon-redwoods relationship. Podcast Fire ecologist Katie Low discusses her work with communities in the WUI—wildland urban interface—and wildland firefighter Saul Tejeda talks backcountry blazes and what it means to be a “sawyer” vs. “swamper.” Escape Not ready for the summer fun to end? There’s still time to slip in an adventure or two. Head into the forest with writer Helena Guglielmino as she shares her favorite backpacking spots in the redwoods. Games Put your nature-loving brain to the test with this redwood-themed puzzle, inspired by the hit New York Times game, Connections. We start our four-part series with Redwoods 101 ... but things could get trickier from here! | | Instagram Post of the Month ---|--- | | ---|--- "The redwoods, once seen, leave a mark or create a vision that stays with you always. No one has ever successfully painted or photographed a redwood tree. The feeling they produce is not transferable. From them comes silence and awe." \- John Steinbeck 📍 Portola Redwoods State Park 📸 Adam Kaplan THE LEAGUE IN THE NEWS Salon The New York Times Living on Earth Support our work Connect with us | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- | | Save the Redwoods League 111 Sutter Street, 11th Floor San Francisco, CA 94104 United States |

_**Peter, it's official. We won!**_ **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91192199/493022064/634502765?refcode=240820_ya_history_img&ms=240820_ya_history&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNTk1YjhkNi0yNjVmLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8cihn9tmoCu5R-7ebQPqd7LpAHVeo4Khvfv4dywjGiM=)** It's hard to put my feelings right now into words. I'm elated, of course — but more than that, I'm honored, I'm inspired, and I'm deeply grateful. **This historic victory belongs to all of us, Peter. It belongs to everyone in our Phoenix and Glendale community who believed in a progressive future and went to work for it.** This victory is the product of more than 165,000 doors knocked in the pouring rain and the blistering heat. It's the result of over 25,000 phone calls, and nearly $2 million contributed by folks from every walk of life. We won this primary election without a dime of corporate PAC money. We ran a campaign on progressive policies and real results. BIG NEWS: Beto O’Rourke put a national spotlight on Michelle Vallejo and TX-15 [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91193734/493024051/66213403?source=SBD_MV_EM_FR_082024_1_1_MSNBC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDUzMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNWNlOTY2My0yODVmLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ev-gCh92LN0epGkNeNNe3zvkPbLsUTcPliFqoB0PzJU=) Peter, last week, Beto O’Rourke highlighted Texas’ 15th district as one of the most competitive congressional races in the country, saying what we’ve been saying all along: Electing Michelle Vallejo and flipping this district blue is the pathway to... flipping the House blue,

Friend of Life,

Planned Parenthood just came out with a new video that calls virginity "made up" and a "social construct."

The "educator" in the video tells young people: "It's time to throw away the notion of losing your virginity."

Instead of seeing it as "losing something," Planned Parenthood encourages impressionable teens to experiment sexually because "all of these myths around sex and virginity can be so hurtful and overwhelming."

Planned Parenthood is grooming the next generation for abortion. Promoting risky sexual practices to young people ultimately leads them to broken relationships and more children killed in the womb.

**Will you help fight back against Planned Parenthood 's anti-family, pro-death agenda? In classic Planned Parenthood fashion, irrefutable definitions are warped, and morality is thrown out the window.

Planned Parenthood is the largest provider of sex education in America -- and they teach kids that gender is fluid, deviant sexual practices are normal and healthy, and anything goes, as long as it's consensual.

**We need to protect our children against Planned Parenthood 's deception. This deadly organization should not be the educator of our children. **

Checking my phone every 20 seconds looking for weather reports on the next big storm feels like second nature. But MAGA extremists are so obsessed with taking over our country, they’re even coming for _weather reports_.
You read that right.
If Project 2025 goes into effect, Donald Trump and his cronies will defund public weather services and leave critical information like hurricane updates up to private interests.
**Gutting funding for weather reports is already bad enough. But if Trump and his MAGA zealots get their way, they’ll also dismantle the Department of Education, implement a national abortion ban, and take away our fundamental rights.**

But MAGA extremists are so obsessed with taking over our country, they’re even coming for weather reports. You read that right. If Project 2025 goes into effect, Donald Trump and his cronies will defund public weather services and leave critical information like hurricane updates up to private interests. Gutting funding for weather reports is already bad enough. But if Trump and his MAGA zealots get their way, they’ll also dismantle the Department of Education, implement a national abortion ban, and take away our fundamental rights. Letting Project 2025 take effect would be a disaster all on its own. But lucky for us, we can do something to stop it. Young voters across the country are building the momentum we need to keep Trump and his cronies out of power. # Shape the Future
---
[](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=45ba530fe5&e=0f456155ff)
| We’re at a pivotal moment in our nation’s history. Voting for Kamala Harris and Tim Walz is critical—but it’s not enough. To truly make the change we need, we must also elect leaders in Congress who will work with Kamala to deliver on the promises that matter most to us.

**As Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez put it last night:**
---
| _“We cannot send Kamala and Tim to the White House alone. We must also elect strong Democratic majorities in the House and in the Senate so that we can deliver on the agenda for the people.”_
---
| **Here’s why your vote for Patti Hewitt matters:**
---
|
* **Affordable Healthcare:** Kamala Harris wants to expand healthcare access, but she can’t do it without a Congress that will pass the necessary laws. **Patti Hewitt** will fight to make sure that happens.

* **Economic Security:** From raising the minimum wage to ensuring equal pay for equal work, Kamala’s vision for a fair economy needs a Democratic majority in Congress. **Patti will be that vote.**

* **Climate Action:** Tackling climate change requires bold action, and Kamala’s plan demands Congressional support. **Patti is committed** to pushing forward the policies that will protect our planet for future generations.

---
| Your vote for **Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Patti Hewitt** is a vote for a better future. It’s about more than just one leader; it’s about electing a team that can turn our hopes into reality.

**What can you do?**
---
|
* **Share:** Forward this email to friends, family, and neighbors who may not realize how crucial their vote is.

* [**Get Involved:**](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=be8c6f08ab&e=0f456155ff) Join us in reaching out to others. Together, we can ensure that everyone understands what’s at stake.

* [**Donate:**](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=65f647a557&e=0f456155ff) Your financial support can make all the difference. By contributing to Patti Hewitt’s campaign, you’re helping to fund the outreach, ads, and resources needed to ensure victory.

---
| This is about building the future we want for our families, our communities, and our country. **Let’s make sure that when we wake up on November 6th, we know we did everything we could to secure a brighter tomorrow.**

Thank you for your commitment to this cause.

---

Ritchie Torres represents the future of the Democratic Party. Raised by a single mother in public housing, Ritchie personally understands the hardships that working families endure. At age 25, Ritchie made history as the youngest elected official to serve on the New York City Council. He fought tirelessly for the working families of The Bronx, and now, he's fighting for those families and for progressive values in Congress. body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Hello Democrats! We're excited to share with you our second daily update from Chicago.
Last night, our incredible President Joe Biden gave one of the most beautiful speeches of his career, telling Americans in the arena and all across the country how much he loves this country and how proud he is that he gave his best to all of us for his entire career. There was no one better to make the case for Kamala Harris, and it was amazing. He spoke about their partnership and what she's grown to mean to him, and how powerful her presidency will be. The energy and love in the room was palpable.
We also heard from Secretary Hillary Clinton, the first ever female nominee of a major political party, who told us that there are cracks in that glass ceiling now, and that on the other side of that ceiling is Kamala Harris, ready to serve as our first woman President, and show the world that when Black women step up to lead, we all benefit.
VP Harris surprised us ahead of her keynote address on Thursday! It was so thrilling to see her and to be able to give back to her the energy that she's been giving to this campaign.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/night1_emailimage1.jpg] [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/night1_emailimage2.jpg] [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/night1_emailimage3.jpg]

body:

**Exclusive Updates and Behind-the-Scenes Snaps from Chuck's Campaign Journey!**
|
---
**
****Enjoyed sitting down with Angie & Jon, owners of Sweet River Farm in Deerfield! Like many Granite Staters, they’ve worked hard to build a life for themselves, but inflation and property taxes are hurting that dream.
** **
****As Governor, I will always protect farmers and small business owners across the 603!**********
|
---
**
****The Buckley family hosted a wonderful house party for Team Morse in Derry!** **
****It was a beautiful night to meet new supporters and discuss the important issues facing families in the 603. With only a few weeks before the primary, it’s incredible to see the immense support rallying around our campaign!**
|
---

******Enjoyed an exciting tour of SUBCOM in Newington!**
****
**Their company engineers, manufactures, and installs subsea fiber optic data cables across the globe.**

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_082024_Kids_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_082024_Kids_act]
Peter,
Colored pencils and highlighters. Hand sanitizer. Books, from great novels to science textbooks. Desk chairs.
When we underfund our public schools, our kids end up in oversized classes with overwhelmed teachers — many of whom use their own money to pay for classroom basics.
As a mom and a teacher, I’ve experienced this firsthand in Arizona schools. And when I saw how my daughter, her classmates, and her teacher were suffering from Republican budget cuts, I was motivated to do more.
It’s what first inspired me to run for the Arizona State House in 2016, and why I’m now taking that fight to Congress.
I’m running because I want to build a brighter future for every kid in Arizona.
By defending reproductive freedom , we give parents the power to start a family when they’re ready, financially and emotionally.
By investing in child tax credits , we help working families make ends meet, so they can get food on the table for their kids.
By supporting public schools , we ensure every child has access to a strong education and the tools they need to succeed.
By protecting the environment , we keep our air clean and our water secure for generations to come.
Peter, I’m in a toss-up race against a Republican who is selling Arizona’s 6th Congressional District out for conservative interests. We deserve better than someone who has consistently voted against our kids’ futures.
We’re currently getting outspent by massive corporate and crypto PACs. Can you rush a donation to help us fight back and flip this seat blue? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_082024_Kids_act]

Thank you so much.
Kirsten

Friend, are you ready to vote this November? Republicans have spent years trying to make it harder for Ohioans to vote, so we've put together a comprehensive guide with everything you need to know to make your voice heard in this election. **STEP 1: MAKE SURE YOUR REGISTRATION IS UP-TO-DATE** You can register to vote, check your registration status, and update your voter registration online! Here's what you'll need:
* Your Ohio driver's license or Ohio ID card number
* Your name
* Your date of birth
* Your address
* The last four digits of your Social Security number

**The voter registration deadline for this year's election is October 7, so don't wait! Confirm your voter registration online right now:** **[Online voter registration](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91199713/493042008/1600316439?ms=240820_team_howtovote&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTY1NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZmExMWIzNy0zNTVmLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DwdmqbDiLdQkpmlJlg-6zG2cGVo5_eXhtzN7etXJipM=&emci=5cd00e73-625e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=0fa11b37-355f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=2814549)** **STEP 2: MAKE A PLAN TO VOTE** There are many ways you can make sure your vote is counted this November, friend. You can vote by mail, vote early in person, or vote at the polls on Election Day. Don't leave it to the last minute; make your plan to vote today and make your voice heard! **Early voting begins in-person and by mail October 8th, so there's no need to wait until Election Day. Peter,
It’s been a busy start to the week in Chicago as thousands of Democrats come together to finalize our ticket and put the finishing touches on this year’s party platform. **And Pramila is working hard to put the spotlight on our movement!**
[**Can you pitch in $3 so Pramila can keep fighting for progressive priorities like Medicare for All and ending the influence of big money in government?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20240820?refcode=em20240820&amount=3&refcode2=4219_420207_0Wy4GX&akid=4219%2E420207%2E0Wy4GX)

[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20240820?refcode=em20240820&amount=3&refcode2=4219_420207_0Wy4GX&akid=4219%2E420207%2E0Wy4GX)

These folks are doing the hard work to organize our communities and protect our democracy, and we owe them all a huge thanks!
Tonight will have more excitement — rumor has it we’ll be hearing from Barack and Michelle Obama! And don’t forget to stay tuned later this week to hear from Tim Walz and Kamala Harris as they continue to lay out their vision for a better, fairer America.

## Biden "passes the torch" past primetime...
.Many Democrats who are supporters of Biden thought his late night (he didn't start until past 11:30pm ET) was demeaning to the former president - clearly past primetime but most importantly WELL past when most people had gone to bed. It was just the last insult to Biden from his party. But if you listened you can see why they did it -- he reminded them -- VERY clearly - why they pushed him out 30 days ago.
## Trump's pollster tells us what messaging is working...
[](https://substack.com/redirect/046376e2-e5e1-4308-9630-a949d3cb00e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Friday we've got Trump campagin's political director James Blair joining us -- you all know that I've been saying this is a turnout election meaning its all about who has the better ground game, and James Blair is leading that effort for the Trump campaign.
[Don't miss it, subscribe now](https://substack.com/redirect/2be9f7d7-528e-451c-82c7-fb7b7663012d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
## Stories I'm Reading...
[Tim Walz's wife confirms she never underwent IVF despite him heavily suggesting she did](https://substack.com/redirect/222cc432-b2e4-4b6f-bf25-d0fbe2bbbc8a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- via New York Post
This is becoming a pattern isn't it - his military service, his DUI, and now this. He has a problem with telling the truth. For all the media and leftist hype about Trump not telling the truth it seems the quick vetting process missed a lot.
[Several protesters break through security fence near United Center as thousands gather for DNC](https://substack.com/redirect/7f423387-24ae-45ee-bdf3-757ea4e0a670?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- via Chicago Tribune
> My take: Serious question for the apologists in the media, how much violence and damage has to occur before it's not "mostly peaceful"?
[Women are better off with President Trump in office](https://substack.com/redirect/7d239fe6-15f9-4d03-8a91-9e8068d9f5d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- via Rep Elise Stefanik in Real Clear Politics
[Trump announces White House transition team -- his sons included](https://substack.com/redirect/e0387677-a512-4dc7-859f-a6f233639ef0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- via NY Post
> My take: no one better than Linda McMahon to lead this effort.
['Washington Post' reviews star columnist Taylor Lorenz's 'war criminal' jab at Biden ](https://substack.com/redirect/babb1ee5-91e6-4a3c-8d7f-2cedce411c65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)-- via NPR
> My take: This is misinformation being peddled by NPR, she's _**NOT**_ a star. It will be interesting how this ends -- she initially lied about the posting and then after it was proven authentic suddenly became quiet when they announced they were investigating.
## Things that WILL sway the election...
From Politico:
